This tiny box gives your older tech smart home superpowers – and it’s only $69

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.zdnet.com/home-and-office/home-assistant-connect-aux-2-hardware-older-tech-smart/

Our gifting experts are obsessively searching for holiday gifts that are unique, thoughtful and suitable for any budget.

Home Assistant gets new equipment to battle planned obsolescence and abandoned cloud services.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, home assistant is perhaps the most versatile smart home automation system of them all, thanks to the extreme customization power it offers. Today, a tiny, new box-shaped device is giving Home Assistant users a way to make their existing electronics smarter, rather than replacing them to keep up with the times.

Also: Ring’s new drone patrols your home to keep an eye on things.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the home assistant connect aux-2 is a multi-purpose piece of hardware made by nabu casa, the company behind official home assistant hardware. The device brings together several connectivity options, including RS-232 serial for older TVs and other equipment, and the ability to connect older stereo systems and amplifiers to modern multi-room audio setups.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “the most sustainable device is the one you already own,” said paulus schoutsen, founder of home assistant and nabu casa. “No device should be left behind because it doesn’t have smart capabilities, or worst of all, its cloud services get turned off.

With the AUX-2, Home Assistant is joining the fight against planned obsolescence and abandoned cloud services.

Berdasarkan laporan, modern smart home systems have a major drawback: they exclude working electronics simply because they weren’t designed to integrate with today’s smart home platforms. This is the problem that the AUX-2 addresses.

Instead of buying a new stereo system with smart features, consumers can use the $69 AUX-2 to make the devices they already own smarter, more connected, and easier to control.

Diungkapkan bahwa a single aux-2 can control multiple devices, depending on how they’re connected and the interfaces they use. The device’s limit has more to do with the number of physical connections required.

Also: How I open-sourced my smart home – and ditched Google for Siri.

Diungkapkan bahwa the aux-2 lets you connect two serial-controlled devices directly through the rs-232 ports. The USB port can act as an expansion for compatible adapters. You can place one AUX-2 on an entertainment center and connect an older stereo and TV, then use another AUX-2 elsewhere in your house for additional equipment with physical serial connections.

According to Home Assistant, with an AUX-2, you can control an old AV receiver without the original app, have an older TV respond to commands without relying on its manufacturer’s cloud servers, or integrate existing audio equipment into modern multiroom sound systems.

This way, consumers won’t need to trash a functional piece of equipment simply because the manufacturer stops supporting it.

Aside from RS-232 serial, the AUX-2 also supports Bluetooth, Z-Wave, USB, PoE, and Wi-Fi for connectivity.

Several creative apps are ready to take advantage of the iPhone Duo's many display configurations.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in addition to giving the iphone line a new design, apple’s iphone duo lets developers take advantage of several new modes to play with. But this early into the iPhone Duo’s general release, apps are still catching up to what Apple’s foldable phone can do.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the shape-shifting design, like on existing foldable android phones i’ve tested, lends itself to creative use cases, such as hands-free entertainment and self-mounting for long-exposure photos. Some of your most frequently used apps may not yet be optimized to take advantage of the added screen space. There’s even a “does it work on iPhone Duo?” web tracker.

Berdasarkan laporan, needless to say, the next few weeks and months will be very telling about the future of apps on the iphone duo. Dozens, if not hundreds, of the App Store’s popular picks are already being worked on to take advantage of the flexible iPhone Duo screen. They’ll be labeled with a “Made for iPhone Duo” badge on their product page.

If you’re one of the lucky few who’s gotten an iPhone Duo (or it’s coming soon), I’ve listed below some of the standouts that have already been optimized for the iPhone Duo and that I’ve personally tested.

One of the primary iPhone Duo use cases is multimedia consumption, whether it’s streaming live sports and keeping tabs on player stats or docking the phone to catch up on the latest episode of Below hands-free.

Berdasarkan laporan, of all the streaming services i’ve used on my iphone duo thus far, netflix is the most polished, with seven (from what i’ve tallied) different orientations for watching movies and shows. There’s the standard widescreen layout when the iPhone Duo is unfolded, as well as the ability to fold it and set it down like a tent.

For something more creative, you can rotate the iPhone Duo to portrait orientation and have the video play in the upper third of the screen while you use a different app in the bottom half.

I’m no Michelin-star chef, but thanks to the dishes I’ve been able to make with the NYT Cooking app, at least my wife hasn’t completely banned me from the kitchen.

Diungkapkan bahwa previously, i’d look through and follow recipes on an ipad air that’s docked on the countertop. With the iPhone Duo, I’ve been setting it down so that one half of the inner screen is lifted, toggling on Cook mode, and increasing the text size so I can comfortably scan the instructions from afar.

There’s nothing more satisfying than shutting the phone closed at the end of cooking and seeing a countertop that’s a little more tidy than before.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i’ve never been a big to-do list guy; i’m the type who just waits for a calendar event to notify me, and i prepare then and there for what’s to come. Fantastical may keep me in better order.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it’s a calendar app that doubles as a task manager and weather tracker, which just makes sense. With the iPhone Duo unfolded, you get a clear view of your day’s tasks and appointments, what the week, month, quarter or even year looks like, and the latest weather forecast. It can easily be an information overload for some people, but I’m a fan of how everything’s color-coded and organized.

Fantastical also supports enhanced Siri AI interactions, so you can add calendar events, to-dos and other happenings through voice or text prompts.

Diungkapkan bahwa for content creators, the edits app is one of the most popular video editing tools. It’s the one I’ve been using over the past year to produce reels and other short-form videos, and the latest update for the iPhone Duo makes my job easier.

Berdasarkan laporan, edits can now show a preview monitor of what you’re editing on one half of the inner screen, while the other half shows your timeline. That means you can comfortably add effects or text, set keyframes, and scrub through the timeline without having to minimize and expand the preview to see how the changes look.

Diungkapkan bahwa that’s also my segue to give flowers to two apps i’ve spent an unreasonable amount of time on: tiktok and instagram. In line with the iPhone Duo launch, both social media apps have been optimized for the foldable iPhone’s larger screen. You can now watch videos on the left side while reading and interacting with comments on the right.

Safe to say, it’s my new favorite way to doomscroll at night.

Toastie is easily the most whimsical “for iPhone Duo” app I’ve used, and it reminds me a lot of the early iPhone days, when chugging digital beer and swiping a paper ball based on the aerodynamics of an office cubicle were the greatest things ever.

The goal of this game is to prepare sandwiches as perfectly as possible, from the way slices of cheese are placed to how evenly spread out the butter is, to the amount of time they’re pressed in the toaster.

Diungkapkan bahwa oh, and you do that last step by folding the iphone duo shut, just like how you would with a panini press. There are even haptic effects that mimic the sizzling of the toast. It’s silly, fancy, and very charming.

Sebagaimana diketahui, during my days testing the iphone duo, there was one configuration i kept going back to: running split-screen mode with two apps. To me, this is what using a foldable phone is all about, and it’s the reason why I’ve stuck with Samsung and Google’s foldable phones for the last several years.

Running split screen effectively makes apps that aren’t optimized for the multidimensional screens of a foldable phone work better by splitting the wider, tablet-like inner screen into two traditional-size phone screens.

Berdasarkan laporan, for my work commutes, i usually keep both google maps (the superior navigation app, in my opinion) and spotify open for quick adjustments. During a recent telehealth appointment, I had my video call set up on one half of the screen and my note-taking app on the other.

And during the Lakers’ home opener the other night, I had my fantasy league and group chat open so I could throw shade throughout the game, only to come up short in points for the week because Luka Dončić decided to chuck extra shots during garbage time.

That’s why I highly encourage you to head to your local Apple store, experiment with app pairings on the iPhone Duo, and decide whether the two screens actually make you more productive.

#90. Apple HomeView review: A versatile smart display and Siri-powered home hub

📅 12 Nov 2026

Apple HomeView review: A versatile smart display and Siri-powered home hub

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.engadget.com/2313999/apple-homeview-review/

The company’s smart screen debut heavily relies on an iPhone or iPad — for better and for worse.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, apple's entry into the smart display category was rumored for years. By the time its debut home hub device arrives this week, the company will be nearly a decade behind its main rivals in the space. In true Apple fashion, it refused to rush new products just because most of the competition was doing it. Now that the HomeView ($299) is here, Apple is hoping the iPhone faithful will like its mix of elevated design and newly expanded Siri capabilities.

Berdasarkan laporan, unlike smart displays from amazon and google, apple's approach relies on a companion device. That means you'll need either an iPhone or an iPad to mirror apps using technology similar to CarPlay. As you'd imagine, that means the HomeView's usefulness, like CarPlay's, is directly tied to how much you use Apple's core apps — things like Messages, Calendar, Photos, Reminders and others. You'll also need to have some smart home devices to make the most of the smart display and be willing to use Safari as your recipe box. If all of that is OK to you, and if you're willing to give Siri access to personal data inside some of those apps, the HomeView can quickly become a very versatile device with something for your whole family.

Diungkapkan bahwa i have fond memories of the imac g4. The first time I saw the HomeView, those memories flooded back. It was the first computer I used in a design lab in college, and I loved how I could reposition the display to suit the task at hand. Apple's smart home display doesn't exactly replicate the G4 styling, but it's close enough for a decent nostalgia hit for me.

Diungkapkan bahwa the homeview essentially consists of two parts: a cylindrical, domed base and a 7-inch liquid retina display. 95 for a mount. Every version of the HomeView has two full-range drivers in the display itself. The wall-mounted option is just the screen, and you'll have to pay at least $59. At least, that's if you get the tabletop version. The base houses additional components, like a down-firing woofer and a pair of force-canceling passive radiators for fuller sound with more bass than the wall-mounted models.

Berdasarkan laporan, that display has an led-backlit multi-touch ips panel that offers a 1,088 x 1,088 resolution at 200 pixels per inch. 3 nits — the lowest brightness ever on an Apple display. There's an ambient light sensor that enables the HomeView to adjust both brightness and warmth as needed. If it's in direct sunlight, you can expect the maximum 500 nits, but at night, it can dial things down to just 0. Apple says it also added an oleophobic fingerprint-resistant coating to cut down on grime from everyday use. The company believes this makes it perfect for a nightstand, if you're willing to have a camera pointed at or near your bed.

Berdasarkan laporan, the homeview's display has bezels like an ipad and the shape of a large apple watch. While that will suit most of your needs, I'm sure there are a lot of people who would've liked the ability to change the height or rotate the screen as well. All of the interaction is done via swipes and taps on the touchscreen itself, or, as I'll elaborate on in a bit, with your voice. And unlike that iMac I'm nostalgic for, you can only tilt the display — you can't adjust its height. Unlike either of those devices, though, it has no physical buttons for controls. Once you do adjust the way it tilts, a built-in accelerometer detects the new angle and alters the audio performance of the display's two drivers to match it.

Berdasarkan laporan, another item to discuss in terms of design is the homeview's lone port. Around back, there's a single USB-C jack for power. The company offers a 40W dynamic power adapter (up to 60W max) for $39 while the minimum required power supply (20W) will cost you $19. Apple ships the standard version of the device with a USB-C to USB-C cable and a 30-watt power adapter. If you opt for the USB-C wall mount, which already costs $59. 99, you'll need to purchase the power adapter separately. Obviously, the AC wired and PoE (power over Ethernet) wired mounts won't need a power adapter.

Diungkapkan bahwa and lastly, there's the matter of color. On those, the sides and back of the display match the base. For the standard (table or countertop) version of HomeView, you can choose from Silver, Starlight, Rose Pink or Space Gray options. For the wall-mounted version, you can only pick between Silver and Space Gray. And, just in case you need the reminder, both HomeView models are the same price ($299).

Diungkapkan bahwa one of the homeview's most helpful traits is its ability to put siri ai front and center in your home. The smart device runs on Apple's A18 chip, the processor that debuted with the iPhone 16 line in 2024. The company is using it here for its Secure Exclaves which give it the ability to process camera and microphone feeds on-device in a manner that can't be accessed by Apple. The company explained that this enables the HomeView to recognize your face and voice, or that of other users in your home, without exposing any of the data to the operating system.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that's important, because siri ai now has access to more of your personal data, like your conversations in messages, info from your calendar invites and other bits of "personal context" from various apps. Of course, you have to opt-in to all of this by enabling Apple Intelligence on your iPhone or iPad, and you can limit which apps Siri can index data from. If you do decide to use the system, I can attest that it works well on the HomeView, though it's merely another vessel for the larger AI system.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, during a lengthy conversation about lighthouses in north carolina, siri gave me information about visiting a variety of locations in the state. It provided information that I didn't specifically ask for, like which ones were still active, and got more comprehensive when my follow-up query was a bit vague. For example, when I asked "Which lighthouse is the easiest to get to?" Siri responded with both a list of ones you can park close to and highlighted the one that requires the least amount of climbing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, siri was able to check my calendar to see if i was free to take the trip on a certain date and provided travel time from my house (including follow-up questions about the cities i'd pass through). I was finally able to stump the AI when I asked about "good hotels" near the Currituck Beach Lighthouse in Corolla, but even still, things felt more natural and conversational than interactions I've had with Siri in the past.

Diungkapkan bahwa at times, siri showed text answers on the homeview in addition to reciting the info. When I asked about driving time or my schedule, a preview of the best route and the specific day on my calendar popped up respectively. What's more, I got a notification on my phone from the Home app letting me know Siri responded to a request for personal content. But it's important to remember that HomeView is just a conduit for Siri AI and its newly expanded abilities. These same things can be done on an iPhone or other compatible Apple devices, meaning you don't really have to spend $300 on a dedicated display for these tools.

Berdasarkan laporan, one final note on security: since the homeview is heavily reliant on an iphone or ipad, those devices must be nearby and recently unlocked (and enrolled in the shared home) for siri to access personal data. The HomeView uses facial and voice recognition to know who's speaking, and to know when they walk away, so prying eyes can't see your texts if they rush over after you've been looking at Messages or other potentially sensitive apps. Guests or family members who don't have an iPhone or iPad can still use basic functions (control smart home devices, check weather, play music, etc), including asking Siri rudimentary questions.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when i first spent time with the homeview last month, the feature i was most excited about was the recipe integration in safari. I'm happy to report that feeling remains, for the most part, but there's one caveat that does impact the overall experience.

Diungkapkan bahwa let's back up for a second. On the HomeView, you can view a recipe link in Safari from your iPhone by holding it close to the display (just like you do to pass audio from your phone to a HomePod). Tapping that will launch the HomeView's streamlined mode for the kitchen, which shows a recipe image with the dish's name, creator, cooking time and servings. Once the page loads, you'll see a cooking icon (a spoon and recipe card) in the bottom right corner. There are two options underneath: Ingredients and Start Cooking.

Berdasarkan laporan, the ingredients option gives you a checklist-style collection of what you'll need for the recipe. If you need to add things to a shopping list in Reminders, Siri can do that for you. I had no trouble getting the AI assistant to add various ingredients to different shopping lists I have in that app (Costco, grocery store, etc). The HomeView will show its work by displaying the new entry in the Reminders app, and a Live Activities shortcut at the top allows you to quickly get back to the recipe with a tap.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, once you hit start cooking, the recipe's steps are divided into swipeable slides with inline shortcuts for any timers you need. Or, at least that's how it's supposed to be. While testing the HomeView, I pulled in recipes from my go-to cooks, and while some of them worked just like Apple advertised, others did not. This isn't a massive deal breaker, as you can still read the recipe's steps, but once you've experienced the correctly formatted version, it's hard to go back.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, going back means you'll get all of the steps on a single slide, requiring you to scroll instead of swipe. This is a long block of text, which can be overwhelming, especially compared to the short, easy-to-follow slides that alleviate some of the stress from following complicated instructions. And if you ever need to peek back at that ingredients list, the properly formatted versions have an always-present shortcut in the bottom right corner. To be clear, the formatting isn't an Apple problem; it's entirely up to the creator or publisher to present their recipes a certain way. I'm just pointing this all out to say Apple is advertising the ideal scenario, which is honestly an excellent experience, but you may not encounter it every time you cook with HomeView.

Diungkapkan bahwa another big piece of the homeview puzzle is its ability to act as a smart home hub. There's a Home dashboard that shows everything you've connected to the system. With the Home app and devices compatible with HomeKit and Matter, this display becomes the command center for your cameras, thermostat, lighting and more. You can then create scenes and automations, or ask Siri to handle those for you.

Berdasarkan laporan, we'll get to homeview customization in a bit, but it's important to mention two home faces here. Of course, you can always ask Siri to do things for you by summoning the assistant on the HomeView. These give you control over each connected gadget, including the ability to check a camera feed, without opening any apps on your phone. The Home Modular face puts your favorite smart home devices on the same screen thanks to customizable widgets. I'm sure Apple's AI is tired of adjusting my thermostat at this point, as that's what I've primarily been doing during my testing.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there's also a home camera face that's all video, all the time. If a visitor is detected, you can just tap on the HomeView to unlock a smart door lock (provided you have one of those, of course). Here, you can livestream up to nine feeds at once, giving you the ability to keep tabs on things wherever you have cameras positioned. We are a Blink household, though, and those aren't yet compatible with HomeKit, so I wasn't able to test any of Apple's camera features.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you have an icloud+ subscription, homeview works with compatible security cameras (again, homekit and matter) to detect people, pets, packages and vehicles. When any of those are seen, you'll get a notification and a live feed on the display. HomeView can also detect smoke or carbon monoxide alarms and send alerts to your iPhone, iPad or Apple Watch — even when you're away from home. That feature, known as Sound Recognition, is also available on the HomePod and HomePod mini.

Berdasarkan laporan, the homeview's speakers make it a solid option for music, podcasts and other audio entertainment. But, despite its crisp, vivid display, the device is not well-suited for watching videos. That's OK though, because right now, the only video app that's available on HomeView is Apple TV. I would love to see Apple bring F1 multiview to this display though, putting two small alternate feeds below the main broadcast. And unless you like watching your shows within a thin band that sits in the middle of a square display, flanked by thick black bars on the top and bottom, you, too, will find the video experience on HomeView underwhelming. Yes, they'd be tiny, but at least that's a better use of the space and eliminates the awkward black bars.

Diungkapkan bahwa the homeview runs on the same platform as carplay, which is why the various video streaming apps you have on your iphone don't show up on this device. Apple says third-party developers are welcome to enable their apps for use on the HomeView, but doing so would also mean optimizing them for CarPlay. Only time will tell if developers are going to go through the extra steps of making that happen.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when it comes to audio-only content though, the homeview is great. " Switch to something more chill, like Sam Barber's "If I May," and the acoustic instruments lay a base for the singer's unique vocals. The system never loses other instruments either, as you can easily pick up the guitars in Anberlin's "Gravity. I've been reviewing the tabletop HomeView with a base, so I've enjoyed the added woofer and passive radiators, which balance out full-range drivers with extra bass. Across a variety of genres, bass is tight and punchy, and vocals cut through the mix clearly. I'd classify the sound quality here as the midpoint between the HomePod mini and the larger HomePod. Drums are more subdued here, and the HomeView does well to keep them from overpowering the mix.

Berdasarkan laporan, i should also note the homeview can get pretty darn loud. I measured 87dB with my Apple Watch standing right in front of the device. But I should also warn you that it's not a comfortable listening volume if you're standing close to the display. It might be nice for a party, but you'll likely stay around 50 percent or less for the most part.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, spatial audio with dolby atmos is available on the homeview for compatible music, movies and shows. However, given the compact stature of the device and its limited sonic prowess, you're more likely to notice the excellent overall clarity and even-handed tuning more than any dimensional effects. While watching an episode of Masters of the Air, for example, I found the sound perfectly fine, but wouldn't classify it as very immersive.

Sebagaimana diketahui, apple included a few more entertainment-related conveniences on the homeview that add utility. For one, it works with the HomePod, HomePod mini and AirPlay-compatible speakers for multiroom audio, which allows you to play the same thing everywhere or pick specific songs for each room. When listening to songs from Apple Music, you'll see animated album artwork if an artist has it, and lyrics are available with a single tap. And just like you can with your iPhone and HomePod speakers, you can handoff content from your phone to the HomeView just by placing your handset in front of the display.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the homeview may look like an enlarged apple watch's screen, but the two devices also overlap in another area: faces. You can have it just be a clock, as there are three faces just for that purpose, or display your calendar or the weather. There's also an animated Snoopy face that updates based on the time of day, weather, holidays and sporting events. These screens are what you see when the HomeView is in what I like to call rest mode, when it's just sitting there not being actively used. Then there are the two Home faces that work with smart home devices that I already mentioned.

Diungkapkan bahwa those all have their purpose, but my two favorites are the photos and modular faces. If you do that last one, new photos will automatically appear every time they're added to the collection. The Modular face is what I've used most, as its customizable collection of widgets puts the calendar, date, time and weather in one spot. The former makes the HomeView a digital picture frame and you can get specific about what shows up there. You can opt for it to cycle through photos of specific events (Memories), people, pets or cities, for example, but you can also set up Shared Albums that it will source from. Of course, you can pick and choose what shows up here based on your needs or preferences, you're not forced to use the same combination I do.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the best thing about faces is that you can easily switch between them by swiping horizontally on one. A long press brings up the face customization interface where you're free to fine-tune things like color and widgets (where available) to your heart's content.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one feature that apple has spent a lot of time showing off on the homeview is facetime. Of course, the Center Stage software will keep you centered in the frame as you move around, which will be handy if you need to take a call from the kitchen while you're cooking, for example. You can start FaceTime calls on the HomeView, or you can hand them off from your iPhone. The smart display has a 12-megapixel Center Stage camera in its top bezel, which means you can conduct video chats without reaching for your iPhone. I'll also note that you can take voice calls from the HomeView, and in general, the device works well for both types of chats.

Diungkapkan bahwa find my is also available on the homeview, allowing you to locate everything from your iphone to your airpods, or anything that has an airtag attached to it. The intercom feature from HomePods is on the HomeView as well, which comes in handy if you have multiple Apple speakers spread throughout your house. Of course, you can also use this to find family and friends who are sharing their location with you. It also works with the iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, plus you can send and receive intercom messages from anywhere — not just inside your home.

Berdasarkan laporan, lastly, live activities displays real-time info for a variety of tasks on homeview. I found it also surfaced audio controls for my go-to podcast app Pocket Casts as well. Like it does on your iPhone, the feature puts your progress at the top of the display on a floating, tappable button. One thing that doesn't show up there that I wish it did is Live Activities from the Sports app. Live Activities on the HomeView are a bit limited though, only capable of showing active timers/alarms, FaceTime calls, Safari media playback and Now Playing controls for Apple Music or Apple TV. It would be great if the live scores for my favorite teams or an update on who's leading the F1 grand prix were available at a glance.

Berdasarkan laporan, apple is years behind the competition when it comes to smart displays. The company's two main rivals in this category, Amazon and Google, have been honing their products since 2017 and 2018 respectively. The premise has always been similar to Apple's: a combination display and speaker that's a conduit for each company's virtual assistant — or in 2026 terms, each company's AI.

Berdasarkan laporan, amazon's current echo show lineup has six options, ranging from 5 inches up to 21 inches, with the largest models ditching the speaker base for a wall mount or stand. Google's current slate of smart displays is much more modest, with only the aging second-generation Nest Hub and Nest Hub Max as the available options. The most affordable, the Echo Show 5, is $100. Those are going for $100 and $229 respectively, and only the pricier of the two has a built-in camera for video calls.

Diungkapkan bahwa apple may have lagged behind the competition on introducing a smart display, but the homeview checks a lot of boxes that make it a very powerful option for iphone users. The ability to automatically distinguish between different family members, and for Siri to pull in personalized context for each person, makes this a useful home hub. When you factor in the cooking assistance, smart home compatibility and FaceTime chops, the HomeView can easily become the command center for any household. It's also more elegantly designed than all of its main competitors. Just be sure to keep your iPhone (or iPad) handy if you want to make the most of it.

#93. Nancy Pelosi’s replacement is ready to regulate AI

📅 09 Nov 2026

Nancy Pelosi’s replacement is ready to regulate AI

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/11/09/1148182/nancy-pelosis-replacement-is-ready-to-regulate-ai/

Berdasarkan laporan, scott wiener has made ai regulation a cornerstone of his political career. Now he’s headed to Congress.

Diungkapkan bahwa as a california state senator, scott wiener authored legislation aimed at curbing the risks of advanced ai. Now, after winning a tight congressional race for former Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi’s open San Francisco seat, he could play a key role in setting federal AI policy.

Diungkapkan bahwa i spoke with wiener on friday, only a few hours after he had been declared the victor. But he was already thinking about AI risk. The previous day, the AI nonprofit METR had released a report that had been widely interpreted as evidence that Anthropic had achieved recursive self-improvement, a phenomenon in which AI meaningfully contributes to its own advancement and AI progress potentially spins out of control.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “it’s very concerning,” wiener said, citing the report as evidence that we are quickly running out of time to regulate ai. “It was my hope that Congress would take decisive action before [the end of] this year,” he said. “That does not appear to be happening. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, wiener has been increasingly focused on ai in recent years, and he’s made many of the ai safety movement’s concerns his own: during our 20-minute conversation, he used the phrase “recursive self-improvement” half a dozen times, for example. “Because it’s moving very quickly, and we could sleepwalk into a disaster. “We need to slow this down,” he says. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, wiener has already had real influence on ai policy. SB 1047, a bill that he authored in 2024, was set to become the first real piece of frontier AI legislation in the country before it was vetoed by California governor Gavin Newsom; he then sponsored SB 53, a lighter-touch bill that Newsom signed. Both bills have inspired proposed federal legislation.

Berdasarkan laporan, wiener’s congressional campaign received over $3 million from public first action, a nonprofit in favor of ai regulation that receives substantial funding from anthropic. That contribution led opponents to criticize him for being too close to the AI industry, but Wiener says that couldn’t be further from the truth.

Berdasarkan laporan, “public first supported me because i was the first lawmaker in the country to introduce ai regulation and the first to pass it and get it implemented,” he wrote in a message after our interview. “The attacks on me for [Public First’s] support were shockingly cynical—literally attacking a candidate who actually regulated AI over Big Tech’s objection and falsely claiming the candidate is somehow too close to Big Tech. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, wiener says that if congress forms a select committee on artificial intelligence—something that democrats have discussed since september—he’d be eager to serve. And he’s enthusiastic about many of the policy ideas floating around Congress. “I think it’s really important to have a strong, empowered, nimble federal regulator,” he says, noting that Representative Ro Khanna, a fellow Democrat from California, has proposed legislation to establish such a regulator.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, he also highlights the importance of whistleblower protections, testing and auditing requirements, and a kill switch requirement, and he wants to see congress leverage its oversight powers to hold the ai labs to account. “This is about the future of humanity, and we want to make sure that the public has a say and that the public knows what's going on,” he says.

Berdasarkan laporan, and as a longtime state legislator, he is opposed to broad federal preemption of state ai laws, which some of the proposed federal legislation would require. “You want the states to be able to continue to be nimble in ways that Congress sometimes is not. “States are, as Brandeis says, laboratories,” he notes. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, above all, wiener says, he wants congress to pass policies with real teeth. “We need to deal with recursive self-improvement. Once you’re in that realm, that really is potentially a recipe for total loss of control. That means taking seriously the possibility of AI catastrophe, something he discusses in the sort of language typically used by AI safety experts. “It’s critically important that when Congress acts, that we do so in a way that is truly meaningful and that meets the moment,” he says. “We’re in a moment that is very dangerous in terms of the risk of loss of control over AI,” he told me. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, he’ll have some allies in the fight against catastrophic ai risk. But there’s still a large gap between Wiener’s Bay Area, AGI-pilled perspective and the national mood on AI, which is anchored by opposition to data centers. Senator Bernie Sanders, for instance, has met with many of the AI safety movement’s most influential figures and has spoken repeatedly about AI and existential risk. The fact that voters approved 40 out of 41 anti-data-center ballot measures on Tuesday might seem to be a good sign for Wiener and others who support AI regulation, but Wiener says he sees this movement as far more tied to local concerns than to bigger questions about AI risk.

Berdasarkan laporan, “peoople who are really opposed to where ai is going—this is an area where they can actually do something about it,” he says. “But the data center revolt—to me, I think it’s more so that people are upset that there could be something like this in their community, with all the impacts near people’s homes, driving up electric bills and using water. I think that’s the bigger issue for most people, from what I can tell. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, wiener describes himself as only “cautiously optimistic” about congress’s ability to rein in ai, given its poor track record on regulating the tech industry. He also has concerns about the ability to get legislation past President Donald Trump, who called concerns about catastrophic AI risk a “hoax” in September and has demonstrated a stark unwillingness to collaborate with China, something that Wiener sees as essential to preventing the worst consequences of AI.

Diungkapkan bahwa but he says trump’s unpredictability provides  some measure of hope, though it’s a fraught kind of hope. “So far what we’ve seen are some problematic things, but not complete disasters,” Wiener says. “I hope that it doesn’t take a disaster to spur the president into acting. And I hope if that’s what it does take—which, like I said, I hope it doesn’t—but if it does, I hope it’s as small as possible. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in addition to a mobile connection upgrade, users are getting better wi-fi, too. #98. Jensen Huang’s exit puts Nvidia’s support for open source in question

📅 12 Nov 2026

Jensen Huang’s exit puts Nvidia’s support for open source in question

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/jensen-huangs-exit-puts-nvidias-support-for-open-source-in-question/

The open source community just lost one of its strongest advocates.

Diungkapkan bahwa nvidia ceo jensen huang resigned thursday after he admitted to an affair with an alleged chinese spy, raising concerns about u. S. national security and the motives behind the executive’s support for softer chip export controls on China.

Berdasarkan laporan, huang has been a staunch supporter of open source ai, framing the ecosystem as good for safety, innovation, diffusion, and sovereignty. And as frontier AI labs increasingly move to reduce their reliance on Nvidia and build their own chips, supporting open source is also a good way for the company to diversify its customer base by selling chips to nation-states, enterprises, and any organization that wants to own its own models.

Still, Huang’s resignation raises questions about whether Nvidia will carry on his legacy by continuing to support the open model community.

Jensen no longer being CEO would be very very bad for the open model cause in the US.

Sebagaimana diketahui, huang’s departure also comes as nvidia has yet to finalize a deal to acquire open source platform hugging face for $13 billion. Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue said in a post on X that the company would continue to fight for open source, whatever happens next.

Nvidia also agreed to pay $6 billion for a non-exclusive license for open AI coding startup Poolside’s technology.

Sebagaimana diketahui, within nvidia, huang pushed for the development of the nemotron family of open-weight ai models built for long-running agentic ai systems and reasoning workloads — potential competitors to closed frontier models. One company insider told TechCrunch that they don’t expect a change in leadership to have an impact on Nemotron development.

Huang also backed companies that would make American open models more competitive, investing in startups like Reflection AI and Thinking Machines Lab.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, huang’s influence extended beyond nvidia’s investments and product roadmap. He also emerged as one of the most prominent voices pushing back against Washington’s efforts to restrict the open AI ecosystem.

Diungkapkan bahwa earlier this year, huang wrote an open letter signed by 25 companies, including microsoft, meta, ibm, and palantir, urging the u. S. government not to over-restrict open-weight AI models, many of which come from China.

Berdasarkan laporan, the impetus for that letter was washington’s debate over how the u. S. should respond to allegations that Chinese AI labs are stealing intellectual property from American counterparts like Anthropic and OpenAI, both of which have reportedly appealed directly to Washington on the matter, urging stronger protections.

That combination of Huang’s personal visibility and Nvidia’s market power made him the strongest counterweight to arguments from closed-model providers like Anthropic and OpenAI, which have advocated for greater restrictions on advanced AI models due to safety reasons.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, without huang, the concern among open source community members is that whoever takes over will be more cautious. Nvidia has named CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO. It’s not clear how Kress will approach the Hugging Face deal or support for the open model ecosystem, but founder-driven priorities tend to get a downgrade when leadership changes.

Huang’s exit could also strengthen the arguments of those in Washington who are arguing for tougher restrictions on Chinese AI companies, particularly as the scandal surrounding his relationship with Alice Huang, the Megaspeed executive and alleged spy, puts renewed scrutiny on his efforts to loosen chip export controls.

Restrictions on open-weight models from China could kneecap competition for American companies, the most powerful of which have kept their models closed.

Sebagaimana diketahui, still, supporting open source isn’t simply a passion project huang pursued out of idealism. It’s increasingly central to Nvidia’s business strategy.

As some of Nvidia’s biggest customers, including Google and OpenAI, develop their own chips, Nvidia has an incentive to cultivate a much broader ecosystem of AI developers and customers.

More players training, fine-tuning, and running models mean more GPUs sold, and less dependence on a handful of frontier labs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, huang may be gone, but nvidia still needs an open ai ecosystem. The question now is whether that commitment can survive without the man who made it a priority.

TechCrunch has reached out to Nvidia for comment.

This article has been updated with information from an Nvidia employee.

#99. Apple TV 4K (4th gen) review: Still great, but drastically more expensive

📅 12 Nov 2026

Apple TV 4K (4th gen) review: Still great, but drastically more expensive

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.engadget.com/2314410/apple-tv-4k-4th-gen-review/

The $150 price increase is hard to swallow.

Berdasarkan laporan, the apple tv 4k has been our pick for the best premium streaming device since the third-gen model arrived in 2022. In terms of pure performance, it was undoubtedly the best you could buy, thanks to the combination of picture quality, speed and features you wouldn't find on any of the more affordable competition. That was true four years ago and it's still true now.

Diungkapkan bahwa unfortunately, the global tech landscape has changed massively over the last two years. Apple's streaming box didn't escape that fate. Nearly every device is more expensive, especially if it needs RAM or its own processor. For the 4th-generation Apple TV 4K, Apple made big upgrades to performance and added a slew of new features, and of course, it carved out a more prominent place for Siri AI in your living room. The compact streaming box is a lot more expensive than the previous generation cost at launch, though, and the new $299 price tag certainly dulls its shine.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you were hoping for a new design, there are only subtle tweaks to report. You'll be forgiven for not noticing. 24mm bigger in width and depth, and 3 grams heavier. 4 inches x 0. If you dive into the spec sheets, you'll discover the new model is slightly larger than the previous version. The Siri Remote, however, is exactly the same size at 1. I'm talking 0. 4 inches x 5. The most evident is that Apple moved the light on the front of the box from the right to the center. 36 inches.

Berdasarkan laporan, apple upgraded the processor from the a15 bionic to the a19 chip. The company says that the A19 chip is capable of 50 percent faster CPU performance and up to 2x faster GPU performance than the previous Apple TV 4K. In iPhone terms, that would be like going from an iPhone 13 to an iPhone 17, so the computing power increase here is significant. I don't have the tools to quantifiably check those claims, but I can tell you the device is super responsive, navigation is speedy and overall the UI is noticeably more fluid. Plus, the A19 delivers a dedicated AV1 decoder for HDR rendering efficiency.

Berdasarkan laporan, of course, the a19 offers a boost to siri ai, which is playing a bigger role in the living room thanks to the new apple tv 4k. Like before, Apple's AI can help with finding and playing live TV, movies, shows and sports from your go-to apps. You can simply speak your queries while watching TV and Siri is off and running. So when you want Siri to "play the show Jack texted me about," the assistant knows just what to do. But with Siri's recently expanded capabilities, it can now pull in personal context from Messages and other apps too. For starters, the streaming box now has three far-field microphones built in, so you no longer have to use the remote to interact with the assistant. Additionally, audio captured from the far-field mics is processed within the Secure Exclave on the A19, so neither the apps, the OS nor Apple get access to any of the data.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the new feature that will get the most use at my house is precision finding for the remote in the find my app. And when I can't hear it, Precision Finding is better than the previous method for locating the remote with an iPhone. I have two kids who are constantly leaving the remote in undisclosed locations, so the added ability to play a sound has already greatly reduced the amount of time I spend searching for it. With the built-in mics for Siri though, a lost remote is much less frustrating since you can just tell the Apple TV 4K what to do.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's also a noteworthy audio upgrade on the apple tv 4k. Now you can use up to four of those, so long as they're second-gen HomePods or HomePod mini 2s, for a more complete home theater surround sound system. Before, you could only use two HomePod or HomePod mini speakers as a stereo pair. So you can have two HomePods in the front and two HomePod mini 2s in the back, which is the configuration I tested. The only additional requirement is that the two front speakers and two rear speakers have to match. If you have four of the same speaker, that works too.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, once you have all of the homepods in place, you'll hear a series of tones as the apple tv 4k locates the speakers and tunes the audio for the room. The HomePods provide the added bass needed for action scenes, or really just for a fuller soundstage most TV viewing will eventually require. I suspected that a combination of HomePods and HomePod minis is the ideal setup and my testing proved me right. I think having four HomePods would be overkill, not to mention expensive. The HomePod minis can't do that on their own, but they do well as rear speakers, providing dimensional backup to the larger speakers at the front. I also heard a four-mini configuration during a demo last month, and while it's certainly a boost compared to TV speakers, it's not nearly as potent as the arrangement I tested at home.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i'll also note that there's a feature called whole room audio that will be great for parties and gatherings. This ensures that everyone hears everything, from vocals to guitars, or even the commentators of an F1 race. This allows for all four speakers to play the same sounds, rather than the fragments each might deliver in a surround sound setup. Whole Room Audio is also easy to activate as it's accessible from the Speaker Mode option in the Control Center.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, like it has in the past, the new apple tv 4k can function as a smart home hub. This allows you to control HomeKit and Matter accessories like cameras, locks and thermostats, and Apple says "thousands" of such devices are compatible. Thanks to the HomeKit Secure Video, you can expect secure local processing on the streaming box, which encrypts clips before they're stored in iCloud. Apple Intelligence provides captions for camera feeds and you can control everything from the Control Center.

Diungkapkan bahwa siri voice control is available as well, as is the ability to run scenes from the home app in the control center. If you have a HomeKit or Matter compatible camera (I don't), you can get a live view of those in the top right corner of your TV screen. If someone rings the doorbell, you can also choose to be automatically notified on the display you're already looking at. If needed, you can chat with them and unlock the door without leaving your seat.

Sebagaimana diketahui, my biggest complaint about the fourth-gen apple tv 4k is the price. Sure, Apple increased the price of the third-gen Apple TV 4K from $149 to $249 earlier this year, and a lot has happened since that model debuted in 2022. However, even with rising memory and component costs, tacking on another $50 to the already inflated price tag is adding insult to injury. At $299, this model is $150 more than the equivalent version of its predecessor was at launch. It especially stings when you consider the company actually decreased prices when it launched these models in 2022.

Sebagaimana diketahui, to pour more salt in the wound, apple got rid of the cheaper wi-fi-only option that also offered less storage space (64gb). In 2022, that version of the third-gen Apple TV 4K launched for $129, though it eventually went up to $199 this year. If you'll allow me to dig even deeper into Apple TV 4K history, that $129 model was not only $50 cheaper than the W-Fi-only version before it, but even doubled the 32GB onboard storage. Its original price was a drop from the $179 that the comparative version preceding it cost. Meanwhile, the fourth-gen Apple TV 4K only comes in one configuration and it has 128GB of storage; that's the same capacity as the priciest model of the previous generation.

Diungkapkan bahwa after living with the apple tv 4k's new home theater setup with four homepods, i'm starting to question how many people will actually use it. Not only does it require you to have four of Apple's speakers, but you'll also have to put all four of them in the same space. Not to mention you'll miss out on multiroom audio and features like Intercom, which are more helpful if your HomePods are spread around the house. When you consider one of the primary functions of a HomePod is to serve as a direct line to Siri, permanently putting all four in your living room seems like a waste. After some testing, it seems to me like the quad-Pod speaker arrangement is a neat bonus — something you temporarily pull together for movie night or parties — rather than a substitute for a soundbar or traditional home theater setup.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i have another gripe that is more of a frustration with tvos as a whole, but it's worth mentioning as it relates to the new apple tv 4k. Even if you've added the streaming box to the Home app and assigned it to a room, the Home icon won't appear in the Control Center until you've either added a camera or created a Scene. So if you fire up your Apple TV and can't find your non-camera devices, that's probably why.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i appreciate the fact that camera feeds will be the most useful on a tv. I should also mention that tvOS doesn't have a dedicated Home app; everything to do with controlling your smart home requires digging into the Control Center on an Apple TV. But I think it's silly that I have to create a Scene (manually triggered saved settings) in order to see things like a thermostat or lights on a device that's advertised as a "smart home hub. " At the very least, I want there to be a shortcut in the Control Center for Rooms I've set up in the Home app on iOS, where I can then access individual devices if needed. Or, of course, you could fire up the full app on your phone.

Berdasarkan laporan, in terms of performance, the apple tv 4k remains the best streaming box you can buy. That's been true for a while now, and the upgrades the company made for this version only cements its position at the top of the premium heap. However, with the current state of global technology, specifically the price of anything that uses RAM or a chip like the A19, Apple's streaming device isn't as easy to recommend as it once was.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you're rocking with a third-gen model, i'd urge you to stay put. Yes, you'll miss out on the newest features in that scenario, including the convenience of an always-listening Siri device that isn't a HomePod, but the core of what makes an Apple TV a great device is still there. Heck, I'd even keep my eye out for a used third-gen model. And if you're looking to invest in an Apple TV for the first time, try to hold out for a sale or catch one on the refurbished market. And in late 2026, there's something to be said for saving significant money on a tech purchase.

#101. ‘A Servant Class, Not a Working Class’: Stephen Miller’s Biographer on What Comes Next

📅 13 Nov 2026

‘A Servant Class, Not a Working Class’: Stephen Miller’s Biographer on What Comes Next

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.wired.com/story/a-servant-class-not-a-working-class-stephen-millers-biographer-on-what-comes-next/

Berdasarkan laporan, last week, president donald trump named stephen miller, his longtime adviser and architect of the administration’s widely unpopular immigration agenda, his new chief of staff. With the midterm elections delivering a Democratic majority in both the Senate and the House of Representatives, Miller, whose titles until now were deputy chief of staff for policy and homeland security adviser, will likely play a critical role in shaping the White House’s agenda over the next two years.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there is probably no one who understands miller better than journalist jean guerrero. During Trump’s first administration, Guerrero became fascinated by Miller, who, like her, had grown up in Southern California, surrounded by immigrants, in largely liberal (or at least not hard-line conservative) communities. How, she wondered, did this man, whose family came to the US fleeing antisemitic pogroms, who grew up in close proximity to immigrants, come to align himself with white supremacist and anti-immigrant views?.

Her research culminated in Hatemonger, her 2020 biography of Miller, in which she charted his rapid ascent to power in the first Trump administration and dove into the ideas, mentors, and experiences that formed the foundations of Miller’s beliefs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “stephen miller has been a key player in delivering on president trump’s america first agenda including spearheading the administration’s crime crackdown including in dc and memphis, record setting deregulation, unleashing american energy, dismantling drug cartels, and securing our border. In his new role, he will continue to deliver historic successes for the American people,” says White House spokesperson Lauren Bis.

WIRED spoke to Guerrero about where Miller goes from here in his new role, and the ways in which her understanding of Miller has evolved during Trump’s second term.

This conversation has been edited for length and clarity.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, wired: miller has now ascended to the most powerful role he has ever occupied. Is this something he has always been aiming for?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, jean guerrero: stephen miller has had a disproportionate amount of power for a very long time. He's been so instrumental in so much of what Trump has done, starting from the first campaign to today. So regardless of the role that Stephen Miller's had, he always somehow turns that role into something more than it has been historically.

Berdasarkan laporan, while i haven’t been necessarily talking to people in this administration, i suspected that this was coming, and when i heard the news i wasn't at all surprised. I remember thinking that Stephen Miller was going to, if not immediately then at some point, be named chief of staff because of the fact that he has been the most effective sycophant in Trump's orbit, and has been his longest-lasting and most trusted adviser.

Sebagaimana diketahui, miller’s appointment happened only a few days after a midterm election that some called an “extinction-level” event for republicans. Why right now?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i think trump is hoping that stephen miller is going to somehow get him out of this mess. In the past, when he has been in trouble, he has turned to Stephen Miller and his expertise on anti-immigrant scapegoating to distract people and rally his base, and it has worked. But I suspect that this time it's not going to work, because the American people are so horrified by where Stephen Miller has already taken this war on immigrants.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i think many people on the right are realizing that the violence we saw in ice’s conduct—particularly the shooting of alex pretti and renee good in minneapolis earlier this year—is actually very unpopular. Do you think this will push Miller to change tack or to double down?.

Berdasarkan laporan, i see it as an impetus for him to double down, absolutely. If there's any restraint at all, it'll be on the performative nature of the cruelty and maybe shifting towards a more performative nature on the war on the allies of immigrants and trying to characterize anyone who fights for social justice, not just for immigrants, as domestic terrorists. He's always been driven by a desire to inflame and antagonize and horrify, from the time that he was a teenager to today. I think that is the war that Stephen Miller has been dying to fight for a very long time.

Berdasarkan laporan, i think miller is going to do this in collaboration with surveillance companies and the tech billionaires that he and trump have decided to align themselves with. They're going to continue to attack the right to privacy and the right to free speech. He's always trying to find the most creative ways to target and terrorize and torture the communities that he despises. And among them are not only immigrants, but the allies, the citizen allies of immigrants and people who are marginalized.

Diungkapkan bahwa stephen miller was very influenced by the book the camp of the saints, the white supremacist, dystopian french novel. Reading that book was very illuminating for me, because the heroes are the characters who advocate for wiping out brown immigrants who are approaching by boat, who are cast as a threat to white civilization or Western civilization. In the book, the villains, in addition to the immigrants themselves, are the citizen allies of the immigrants.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you wrote your book during the first trump administration. Has your understanding of Stephen Miller evolved since then?.

Berdasarkan laporan, my understanding of him has really changed. I used to see him fundamentally as a white nationalist, but now I see him more as a class supremacist and as a case study in oligarchic capture.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i came to this conclusion because when i first saw what the administration was doing on the foreign policy front, i was confused. Why would they be interfering in Venezuela or the elections in Honduras, when we know those are the exact types of actions that cause instability and migration? But when he told Jake Tapper, “You can talk all you want about international niceties and everything else. But we live in a world, in the real world, Jake, that is governed by strength, that is governed by force, that is governed by power,” I pulled out my book, and I read back through the sections where he's demanding that the custodial staff at his high school pick up his trash.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is something he did in college too, where he would leave out his trash and protest any requests that he clean up after himself. When he was a teenager, he was really motivated by a desire to keep everybody in what he saw as their place. He didn't mind having immigrants around so long as they stayed “in their place,” where they were quietly serving him and picking up the trash that he was throwing on the floor or leaving on the cafeteria tables.

I realized that before Stephen Miller was a white nationalist, he was a class supremacist.

Diungkapkan bahwa he hated poor people. He hated people who were less well-off than him, because he thought they were inferior to him.

Has this understanding changed the way you think about Miller’s focus on immigration now?.

Berdasarkan laporan, by focusing all the attention on the war on immigrants, it distracts us from understanding that when you have one sector of the population that is being criminalized and forced to stay in the shadows, then they cannot link arms with other workers to demand to live with dignity. Under this new administration, he has reverted to his most authentic self. Stephen Miller wants a servant class, not a working class.

Oura's acquisition of Counsel Health could signal a new dawn for digital care.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, oura has entered into an agreement to acquire ai primary care company counsel health for $625 million. The acquisition of Counsel Health, which was already a partner in the Oura app, will give users access to Counsel’s in-house physicians and 24/7 medical AI.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the oura ring has evolved from its beginnings as a sleep tracker to what its ceo, tom hale, calls “a doctor in your pocket. ” The company has its sights set on making the device a continuous medical companion, and Counsel’s acquisition is one way it’s furthering that mission.

Oura employs its 24/7 health monitoring to recognize potential deviations from a user’s biometric baseline, and the partnership will build on those capabilities by adding more clinical guidance through Counsel Health.

Diungkapkan bahwa the partnership will also connect members with counsel health’s medical ai and in-house physicians to address timely health problems, support, or “prescriptions for episodic health conditions,” the press release said. Sebagaimana diketahui, “oura tells members what’s happening in their bodies, and counsel helps them act on it. This combination expands our addressable market and deepens the value we deliver to every member,” David Shuman, executive chairman of Oura, said in a press release.

This is the third acquisition Oura has made this year, following its acquisition of Galen AI, a conversational and personal health platform that connects smart ring data to medical records, and Doublepoint AI, an AI‑driven, biometric and gesture recognition company that could add voice or gesture controls to Oura’s next smart ring.

Also: I should’ve listened to my Oura Ring when it warned me about my health.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when oura has flagged these concerns to me, i take them seriously, even as my care provider — to whom i show this data — may shrug them off. The Counsel Health acquisition enables medical AI and in-house physicians to contextualize your biometrics when you are sick or managing a chronic condition.

Sebagaimana diketahui, will this acquisition help ease the demand for urgent care clinics? as a regular visitor to and hater of my brooklyn citymd, i hope so. I’m thinking that if I get another bad cold this winter, I could go to my Oura app for help and symptom management instead of CityMD. #108. How You Collaborate With AI on Creative Work Makes All the Difference

📅 12 Nov 2026

How You Collaborate With AI on Creative Work Makes All the Difference

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/ai-collaboration-creative-work-research-findings/

Our gifting experts are obsessively searching for holiday gifts that are unique, thoughtful and suitable for any budget.

Diungkapkan bahwa our expert, award-winning staff selects the products we cover and rigorously researches and tests our top picks. If you buy through our links, we may earn a commission.

A new study dives into the consequences of collaborating with AI on creative endeavors, and what it means for output and satisfaction at work.

Sebagaimana diketahui, did you use ai at your job today? maybe it helped you work faster. But too much AI may reduce both the quality of your work and your satisfaction with the job, according to a study published Nov. 10 in the PNAS Nexus science journal.

The team behind the study knew from prior research that generative AI was a mixed bag, capable of dramatically boosting productivity, but also prone to throttling creative diversity and worker satisfaction.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “the question we wanted to answer was whether these trade-offs are inevitable,” kartik hosanagar, a university of pennsylvania professor of technology, digital business and marketing, and one of the study’s authors, told cnet via email. “Our research suggests they aren’t. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ai is changing work quickly, with dizzying contradictions. Tech companies like Microsoft and Meta are spending millions on integrating AI into their business for greater efficiencies and output, while getting rid of human workers through mass buyouts and layoffs. Workers who use AI report some advantages, like saving 40 to 60 minutes a day at work, while suffering consequences like loss of confidence, loss of skills and a tougher labor market.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, teachers have also sounded the alarm, saying ai is essentially ending homework. Researchers say that if we don’t pay attention to how we collaborate with AI, we could start losing critical thinking along the way.

Diungkapkan bahwa “think about gps navigation. It’s incredibly useful, but many of us have lost the ability to navigate even familiar neighborhoods without it,” Hosanagar said. “Something similar could happen with AI and cognitive skills. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the study by hosanagar’s team focused on the different ways we collaborate with ai on creative tasks. They found that the way we use AI — not just whether or not we use it — has a big effect on the final product and on our perception of the work.

Berdasarkan laporan, “the future of work isn’t just about how capable ai becomes,” hosanagar said, “but how we design the collaboration between humans and ai so as to support a broader set of goals. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the researchers tasked 285 students, split into three groups, with writing assignments over two days. On the first day, no students used AI for writing. On the second day, each group used a different process for writing with AI.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, each of the groups used a separate “collaboration design” when working with the ai on the writing assignment. The collaboration designs represent different ways people interact with AI on the job. All three approaches delivered similar productivity benefits, but differed significantly in quality, satisfaction and creative diversity, according to Hosanagar.

Diungkapkan bahwa in the first group, human confirmation, the ai planned, outlined, wrote and edited the assignment, with the humans just approving the work during each step. In the second, Human Creativity, humans did the outlining and planning, while AI did the writing and editing. In the third, Copilot, humans and AI collaborated during the entire process.

The researchers found that using AI in creative writing did not improve the quality of the work in any of the groups, but it did speed up the task.

Sebagaimana diketahui, people in the human confirmation produced the lowest quality and least diverse work, and participants reported feeling unsatisfied with it. But the other two groups, Human Creativity and Copilot, produced better work at the same speed, with participants reporting a more positive experience.

Diungkapkan bahwa the study showed that the best outcomes happen when humans are actively involved in creative tasks, especially generating ideas and creating outlines, while ai assists with execution, hosanagar said. “The goal shouldn’t be to eliminate human effort, but to direct that effort toward the parts of the process where human judgment and creativity matter most. ”.

It would be good to be wary, too, of the unintended consequences of people playing a smaller role in their daily work as they collaborate with AI.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “our research also suggests that people derive satisfaction from having a meaningful creative role, not simply from producing a good final output,” hosanagar said. “So, we should be thoughtful about what we automate. ”.

Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said today that Starshield has again been disabled on fast-moving drones in Ukrainian territory occupied by Russian forces, and that the US has provided “very little” information about the return of the restriction.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “we have detected speed restrictions on starshield on our ukrainian territory again, in the temporarily occupied parts of ukraine,” zelenskyy said in a speech at the 9th european political community summit in ireland. “The speed limit is back at 161 kilometers per hour—that’s 100 miles per hour. ”.

Zelenskyy’s allegation is that Starshield—the military variant of SpaceX’s Starlink satellite service—stops working on Ukrainian military drones when they travel above 161 kilometers per hour.

Berdasarkan laporan, spacex today denied zelenskyy’s allegation. “This is false. There has been no change,” SpaceX’s media relations department told Ars today when asked if SpaceX has any response to Zelenskyy’s statement that Starshield is being restricted again.

Berdasarkan laporan, spacex has received multiple pentagon contracts to give ukraine access to the military-focused starshield. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk said last month that any decisions on Starshield restrictions are made by the US government. The Pentagon inspector general’s office has since declined a request from US senators to investigate who ordered the restrictions.

Berdasarkan laporan, ukraine officials reportedly said today that they believe the limit was reinstated to put pressure on ukraine in the latest round of peace talks with russia. Zelenskyy said in today’s speech that without satellite connectivity on its drones, Ukraine cannot intercept Russian drones that fly in from the occupied parts of Ukraine.

Diungkapkan bahwa it has often been unclear whether us and ukrainian government officials discussing the restrictions were referring to starlink, the civilian service that isn’t supposed to be used for offensive military purposes, or starshield, which relies on the same technology but is intended for military use. But today, Zelenskyy clearly stated that the current restrictions affect Starshield.

Berdasarkan laporan, “this directly affects our ability to intercept russian jet-powered shahed drones,” zelenskyy said. This means more Russian strikes get through, and more of our people are killed, our civilians are killed, by Russia. Near the front line, we cannot use our aircraft. “These drones come from those [occupied] areas, and because of the speed restrictions, we simply cannot catch up with them in time. Only drone interceptors can operate there. And without the speed we need, shooting down these Shaheds becomes much harder. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, ukraine officials reported the first round of restrictions about a month ago, but the limits were removed by october 24. Zelenskyy said today that Ukraine doesn’t know why the limit is in place again.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “we are trying to get the details from the american side, but so far we know very little,” zelenskyy said. “But some things are very clear. If someone in America is making decisions that basically treat Ukrainian territory as if it is not Ukrainian, then this tells us where things are going. We need to be clear and never recognize Russia’s occupation of Ukrainian territory in any way. ”.

A Financial Times article today described Ukrainian officials’ allegations that the Starshield limit was put back in place to influence peace talks:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, senior ukrainian officials told the ft they believed the speed restrictions were imposed in an effort to pressure kyiv during the latest peace talks with russia, which just concluded in abu dhabi. US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Donald Trump’s son-in-law, Jared Kushner, were in Moscow on Thursday to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin, after which they were set to travel to Ireland to meet Zelenskyy. One senior Ukrainian official said it appeared that Washington wanted to strengthen Russia’s position in the talks.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “these are not random errors, but systematic speed restrictions,” zelenskyy said. “For us, this primarily means a significant complication in intercepting Russian jet-powered drones. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, musk last month accused ukraine of using the starlink commercial service for offensive drone strikes, which he said violates the terms of service. A Ukraine official denied Musk’s accusation and said previous limits imposed by SpaceX already prevented Ukraine’s military from using the commercial Starlink service in the way Musk described.

Diungkapkan bahwa as for the starshield military variant, musk has said that “starshield systems are owned and controlled by the us government. Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS. ” Trump denied making the decision to limit Ukraine’s satellite connectivity, and Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the administration had “no foreknowledge” of the slowdown.

Diungkapkan bahwa we contacted the white house today and will update this article if we get a response. European Commission spokesperson Thomas Regnier said that restrictions on Ukraine’s use of Starshield are unacceptable.

Diungkapkan bahwa “it is not the first time that ukraine is facing starshield disruptions. These reports are deeply concerning and, if confirmed, unacceptable,” Regnier said at a press conference. Starshield services must be restored urgently for Ukraine to keep its soldiers connected, to protect its citizens, and to defend its territory. “SpaceX must have a consistent approach in sharing its services with Ukraine. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa calacanis reposted trump’s post, tagging tim cook and telling him to “keep the seat warm” for huang while “the investigation is sorted out” and saying that “america needs you mr. ” Last night, he also said that Nvidia shareholders should “decide Jensen’s fate after the investigation is complete — not the press or online mobs. Cook. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in a post talking about how he has seen huang show “kindness, humility, care to everyone around him,” fridman said that “i’m in shock frankly at all of this, including the mass hysteria around it. I stand with Jensen. I love America, and I think NVIDIA letting Jensen go is terrible for America. ”.

#113. New York is forcing T-Mobile to stop putting data caps on low-income home internet plans

New York is forcing T-Mobile to stop putting data caps on low-income home internet plans

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.engadget.com/2314341/new-york-is-forcing-t-mobile-to-stop-putting-data-caps-on-low-income-home-internet-plans/

The company was throttling speeds for plans offered under the Affordable Broadband Act.

Diungkapkan bahwa new york's attorney general found that t-mobile was not following the state's affordable broadband act, which sets requirements for offering service to low-income residents. Under the ABA, eligible households must be able to purchase broadband at speeds of at least 25 Mbps for $15 a month or 200 Mbps for $20 a month without additional taxes or equipment fees. Providers are also required to make "reasonable efforts" to promote these low-cost options.

Diungkapkan bahwa the office of the attorney general discovered that t-mobile had placed monthly data caps on its aba plans. According to the press release, T-Mobile would throttle speeds to as low as 650 kilobits per second after a customer had used 50GB of data, which could happen in about four days of typical broadband use. The company was also only offering its ABA plans in areas where it had 5G wireless deployed and was preventing information about those plans on its website from being seen by search engines.

Following the investigation, T-Mobile will remove those data caps, make its ABA plans available in all places in the state where it offers home internet service, and will ensure that search engines can access details about ABA plans.

Berdasarkan laporan, "reliable and affordable internet service is a basic need for all new yorkers, but t-mobile flouted the law designed to help vulnerable new yorkers access it," attorney general letitia james said. I encourage all eligible New Yorkers to enroll in a low-cost home internet plan through the ABA. "My office is committed to seeing the Affordable Broadband Act realize its goal of ensuring that New Yorkers in need are not denied access to affordable home internet. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, in a statement shared with engadget, t-mobile the company said "we have a long history of helping customers in new york stay connected through low-cost broadband, and we're updating our plan to meet the state's requirements while maintaining the same low price. We've reached an agreement with the New York Attorney General that builds on that commitment, provides greater clarity around our offering and makes the plan available to more eligible customers. ".

Update, November 11, 6:20PM ET: Added a statement from T-mobile.
