#150. Five ways Jensen Huang’s ouster from Nvidia could damage the AI industry

📅 12 Nov 2026

Five ways Jensen Huang’s ouster from Nvidia could damage the AI industry

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/five-ways-jensen-huangs-ouster-from-nvidia-could-damage-the-ai-industry/

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s confession that he had an affair (and reports of another one with a direct report) that led the board to oust him on Thursday isn’t just your run-of-the-mill salacious billionaire CEO sex scandal.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in this case, one of his lovers is suspected by the u. S. government of being a spy for China. She’s also an executive of a Singapore-based neocloud that is suspected of smuggling Nvidia chips to China.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, these affairs show undeniably poor judgment by huang and, i’d argue, unchecked hubris on many levels. Such choices are not only a betrayal of his wife of 40 years, they’re also a liability for his company. Sleeping with any Nvidia partner is bad enough, but he also chose one in a tinderbox of a geopolitical situation. Even if Alice Huang’s company wasn’t suspected of helping Chinese firms evade chip restrictions (and he was somehow unaware of this), it was still exploiting a legal loophole by renting powerful AI infrastructure to Chinese companies.

Diungkapkan bahwa it’s those potential national consequences that may land him in a hellscape of ongoing public humiliation. Republican committee chairs are already summoning him to testify in closed-door sessions about the security ramifications.

Diungkapkan bahwa will democrats, who are set to take over key committees when the new congress convenes in january, also haul him in to testify on the hill? no one knows yet, but huang has flaunted his close relationship with president trump. Remember when Trump called him while he was onstage at the All-In Summit in September? Nvidia also donated $25 million to Trump’s ballroom, a deeply unpopular project with American voters. Several Democratic lawmakers have already vowed to investigate the money behind it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in other words, he is a billionaire close to trump. He was — until Thursday — the face of AI and data centers (also a deeply unpopular political topic with voters), and he has publicly admitted to having an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Even though he’s no longer CEO, that seems too juicy a target for Democrats to ignore.

Sebagaimana diketahui, beyond whatever may be coming, huang’s influence has been lost right when he was using it to push the tech industry in a number of directions. These areas have now lost their biggest champion.

Berdasarkan laporan, huang has been the biggest, loudest advocate for open-weight ai models in the tech industry and among government policymakers. Nvidia not only offers its own open-weight models, it also offers a lot of other open source tech for agents, AI security, and more. (That deal is supposed to close in the first half of next year, pending regulatory approval. 9 billion. It has even agreed to acquire the biggest site that hosts them, Hugging Face, for $12. ).

In July, when Anthropic and OpenAI were reportedly urging the Trump administration to ban Chinese open-weight models, Huang organized a letter of support for open-weight models generally (if not Chinese models specifically), signed by hundreds of tech companies.

Berdasarkan laporan, open-weight models give enterprises choice in the market and reduce costs. Without Huang, the next biggest advocate for them is perhaps Microsoft’s Satya Nadella, but he’s not out there organizing the industry to speak up.

Diungkapkan bahwa both openai and anthropic revealed incident after incident this year as their ai agents hacked into others’ networks or performed other misdeeds. Huang loudly proclaimed the AI industry still didn’t need regulation and would deal with safety itself.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as the industry mulled over what they should do (auditors? a finra-like board?), huang rallied the tech industry again. Nvidia got over 100 companies to sign on to his Open Agent Safety Platform, a largely open source effort to solve the epidemic of misbehaving AI agents.

Naturally, this effort hasn’t instantly solved the problem, and now the top spokesperson for self-regulation via technology solutions is out of his position of influence.

Berdasarkan laporan, huang has also been among the loudest voices insisting that ai is an engineered system that creates products, and so can be controlled like any other engineered system. This viewpoint counters the AI doomers and even the big AI labs themselves, which sometimes position their models as on the verge of consciousness (Anthropic) or as alien minds (OpenAI).

While Huang deals with the fallout of his actions, the loudest voice of this counter-narrative is, for the foreseeable future, silenced.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, huang also just convinced a long list of pc makers to buy into his long-time dream of providing cpus (the main processor chips) for them. In this age, when most Americans have not experienced AI beyond a chatbot, he orchestrated a new line of high-end AI PCs geared for running agents locally.

Sebagaimana diketahui, these new pcs are due out this holiday season, and they may sell well for their intended targets: creators, developers, and others already savvy with agents. But now that Huang has become a meme for cheating on his wife with an alleged spy, he’s perhaps not the best choice to help market these devices as a cool alternative to the Mac mini.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, huang demolished his reputation right as bond underwriters (lenders) and bond buyers are pretty much over ai build-out-related debt. Of roughly $80 billion in data center bonds issued this year, nearly half were rated high-risk “junk,” Forbes reports.

Diungkapkan bahwa undeterred, huang has been coming up with ways to continue financing the boom and keep his company’s revenues growing. Certainly, he’s authorized a mind-boggling number of so-called circular deals, where Nvidia buys stakes in companies to fund their expansion so they can buy chips. By some accounts, the company had committed to $750 billion in such deals as of July, Bloomberg reported. In August, Nvidia got even bolder, agreeing to backstop $105 billion in financing for an OpenAI data center in Ohio, CNBC reported.

Sebagaimana diketahui, huang also convinced a whole new set of financiers to pony up. In August, he announced that deep-pocketed PE firms Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR had committed up to $500 billion for data center build outs. He promised them that the data centers’ Nvidia GPUs could be used as collateral because Nvidia was guaranteeing the chips would retain value.

Sebagaimana diketahui, huang sold a vision of nvidia as “investable infrastructure” with a long resale cycle, like airplanes. Then he made the rounds with the financial press, as he often did, to pitch his vision. Now, however, Wall Street is concerned that Nvidia’s stock will crash and take their portfolios, and possibly the economy, with it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nvidia has lost its top salesperson and the ai industry has lost its top hype man. Even if Huang somehow comes back into the public eye to champion AI again, every interview and meeting will be about his sex life, choices, and national security — not his vision for the industry.

We’ll have to wait and see how Nvidia navigates the scandal Huang heaped onto it, but now that the company is finally in its post “founder mode” era, and hunting for a new CEO, it’s doubtful it has the cache to push the industry the way Huang was.

#153. The Hubble Space Telescope Is Sinking. NASA Is Looking for Ways to Keep It Afloat

📅 13 Nov 2026

The Hubble Space Telescope Is Sinking. NASA Is Looking for Ways to Keep It Afloat

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.wired.com/story/nasa-wants-to-keep-the-hubble-space-telescope-afloat/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as telescopes go, few if any are more famous than the hubble space telescope. Over 30 years of operations, the telescope has been essential to groundbreaking discoveries that have fundamentally transformed humanity’s view of the universe. But like all satellites in low Earth orbit, it’s been gradually descending.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this happens because of atmospheric drag, and the hubble space telescope is not equipped with a propulsion system to adjust its own orbit. According to NASA’s analysis, if left unchecked, the telescope will likely re-enter Earth’s atmosphere in 2033 or 2034, eventually crashing back onto the planet.

Sebagaimana diketahui, hoping to delay this conclusion, nasa has issued a formal request for information seeking proposals from the private sector for “in-space servicing” of the famous telescope. This would likely involve raising Hubble’s altitude to extend its operational lifespan, but the agency is also open to industry’s suggestions for managing a safe and controlled reentry or disposal of the telescope while still in orbit. Space companies can also propose upgrades to enhance the telescope’s functionality in its remaining years.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “hubble is a national icon,” nicky fox, associate administrator of nasa's science mission directorate, said in a statement. “Given the time we have until Hubble’s anticipated reentry, we are eager to explore the breadth of possibilities to boost Hubble to a higher orbit while we develop the flagship mission to follow. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the telescope was designed with the expectation that astronauts would perform repairs and upgrades in orbit. Since it was launched in 1990, a total of five service missions have been carried out. The last of these missions was canceled after the space shuttle Columbia disaster in 2003. But NASA later determined that the benefits of servicing Hubble outweighed the risks of a final mission, and in 2009 a crew took measures, such as replacing the battery, to extend the telescope’s lifespan.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is also not the first time nasa has considered private-sector resources for raising the hubble space telescope’s orbit. In September 2022, NASA entered into a nonfunding partnership agreement with SpaceX to investigate the possibility of using the company’s Dragon spacecraft to move Hubble into a more stable orbit. However, according to NASA’s announcement at the time, the agency had no plans to conduct or fund the service mission itself; the study was intended solely to assess commercial feasibility.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, meanwhile, nasa commissioned the private company katalyst space technologies in september 2025 to perform an orbital raise for the swift observatory, which was experiencing faster-than-expected orbital decay. However, the company’s spacecraft, launched in July 2026, suffered an attitude control malfunction, forcing the mission to be abandoned. On November 4, Swift reentered the atmosphere over Indonesia.

Berdasarkan laporan, the problems facing the hubble space telescope are not limited to its drop in altitude. The spacecraft itself is also experiencing malfunctions. After more than three decades in space, only three of the gyros were operational, and one of those was starting to return abnormal readings. In June 2024, NASA announced that it would transition the Hubble Space Telescope to a new operating mode using only one of the six gyros on board to assess the telescope’s orientation. The other remaining functional gyro is now being kept in a ready state for future use.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nasa estimates that a mission to raise the telescope’s orbit will need to be carried out by 2032. In an announcement made in 2022, NASA also explained that if the Hubble Space Telescope could be raised to a higher, more stable orbit, it could continue to observe the cosmos for several more years.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “hubble still has important science ahead of it, and we should be looking at every reasonable opportunity to keep it delivering for as long as possible,” said nasa administrator jared isaacman. “If there are innovative and cost-effective ways to extend the life of an asset already in orbit, we owe it to the American taxpayer and the scientific community to explore them. Extending Hubble’s life would mean more discoveries, more science, and more opportunities to expand our understanding of the universe. ”.

#157. The amazing disappearing exoplanet

📅 12 Nov 2026

The amazing disappearing exoplanet

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://arstechnica.com/science/2026/11/the-amazing-disappearing-exoplanet/

An exoplanet seems to have stopped transiting in front of its host star.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one nice thing about discovering exoplanets is that, once you work out how long their orbits take, they continue to show up like clockwork. The timing is so regular, in fact, that we can use variations to detect the gravitational influence of additional planets in the same exosolar system. And the precise timing is useful in that we can rely on it to point telescopes at the system when we know some of the light we detect has passed through the planet’s atmosphere.

Berdasarkan laporan, on monday, researchers reported on an exoplanet that simply stopped showing up. TOI-2535b is a hot Jupiter-sized planet we’ve been observing as it transits between its host star, TOI-2535, and Earth for about seven years now. But it recently stopped showing up, and researchers suspect that’s due to an unseen companion orbiting in a different plane.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, toi-2535 is one of the many stars with exoplanet candidates identified by tess, the transiting exoplanet survey satellite. And TESS found signs of a Jupiter-sized planet orbiting it every eight days, an orbit close enough to make TOI-2535b a “hot Jupiter” exoplanet. It’s a K dwarf, meaning it’s somewhat smaller than the Sun. At that point, there was nothing especially unusual about it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but a closer look at the data showed two very strange things. First, the timing of when its transits occurred could shift by as much as six hours, a substantial variation for an orbit this brief. That’s typically a sign of gravitational interactions with another planet; depending on the details of that second planet’s orbit, it may slow the first one or accelerate it through a transit more quickly. Since the second planet doesn’t show up in TESS data, it appears to orbit in a slightly different plane, so it doesn’t pass between its host star and Earth.

Diungkapkan bahwa the second oddity is that the transit duration grew progressively shorter in more recent observations. This suggests that, while early observations saw the planet transiting across the star’s equator, later ones involved transits near one of the poles, ensuring that the planet spent less time between the star and Earth. This trend eventually reached its logical end point: TOI-2535b simply stopped transiting in the most recent observations.

Diungkapkan bahwa obviously, gravitational interactions with a planet orbiting in a different plane could potentially alter toi-2535b’s orbit so it no longer passes between toi-2535 and earth. There is also some precedent for the converse happening: a star around which no transits were originally detected but where transits began appearing in later observations. Still, as a Jupiter-sized planet, TOI-2535b should not be that easy to shift, and as the researchers note, “This is the fastest rate of inclination change observed for an exoplanet orbiting a single star. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the second, unseen planet “would need to be either extremely massive or on a highly eccentric orbit,” the researchers noted. So they decided to figure out what sorts of configurations could lead to such rapid changes.

Berdasarkan laporan, to do so, they modeled 300,000 different starting configurations and ran them forward in time. They found there wasn’t a single favored configuration; as long as the planets were in an orbital resonance, things were relatively stable, at least over relatively short periods. So they took the 100 best solutions and ran them forward for a million years.

Berdasarkan laporan, about two-thirds became unstable during that period, which ruled out a couple of the potential resonances. The remaining third shared a couple of features. If it is, the difference would shrink over time, causing their orbits to become increasingly eccentric. One is that the second, undetected planet has to be pretty massive—roughly Saturn-sized at a minimum. The second is that the angle between the orbits of the two planets can’t be that large. Eventually, this results in a close approach between the two planets, followed by instability.

The University of California, Los Angeles has posted a video of one of the better models if you’re having a hard time visualizing all of this.

Diungkapkan bahwa while a second planet hasn’t been detected via the transit method, its gravitational pull on the star should create changes in the radial velocity we could potentially detect. Right now, however, we don’t have enough clean data to detect it. The researchers also say there’s enough noise in the transit timing variations that a third planet in the system can’t be excluded.

Diungkapkan bahwa the question we probably can’t answer with further observations is how this system got into its current state. ) But this friction should also limit the angle between the planets’ orbits. Large planets are thought to form farther out from the star and then migrate inward because of friction caused by the gas in the planet-forming disk. (This inward motion tends to stop when orbital resonances develop. Without some additional event that mixed up the orbits, it’s not obvious how this system could have come to be.

#160. I found a hidden Android tool that solves all my tiny text troubles

📅 10 Nov 2026

I found a hidden Android tool that solves all my tiny text troubles

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.zdnet.com/tech/android-display-help-magnification/

Our gifting experts are obsessively searching for holiday gifts that are unique, thoughtful and suitable for any budget.

Tech > Services & Software > Operating Systems > Mobile OS > Android.

When the print on your Android display is too small to read, and the pinch-to-zoom feature isn't working as expected, try this.

Diungkapkan bahwa how many times have you been on your phone, wanted to read something (a piece of news, a website, etc. ), only to find the text is too small and every effort to zoom in doesn’t work?.

Also: 7 Android accessibility features that can make your life easier.

Berdasarkan laporan, this happens quite often when i’m viewing content in the google news app — especially in the morning, when my eyes are still in “wake up” mode. And it’s not only text. It can be frustrating. Sometimes there’s an image I need to enlarge, but for whatever reason, pinch-to-zoom isn’t working on that particular screen.

Sebagaimana diketahui, fortunately, there’s an option you can enable to ensure you can always zoom in on your android device, no matter what’s on the screen. The option is found in Accessibility and is aptly called Magnification. With this feature enabled, you can quickly zoom in on the screen to enlarge any displayed content. It doesn’t matter what’s on the screen or what app is showing the image, page, or text — Magnification will magnify it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this iteration of the feature has been available since android 15. I found it by accident while poking around the Settings page. Since then, I’ve used it quite a bit, and it’s eased my morning frustration with reading news sites.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the magnification feature is quite simple: once enabled, a magnifier shortcut appears on the screen. One caveat: As long as the Magnification shortcut is enabled, the button remains on your screen. It’s really that easy. Tap that button, and whatever is on your screen will increase in size. You can move the button up and down or to the left or right side of the display, but if you want the feature enabled, the button must remain.

Berdasarkan laporan, the good news, however, is that the button does fade a bit, so it’s not glaring and in your face. You can still see it, but it gets just enough transparency that it doesn’t stand out all that much.

Also: Android is getting my favorite iOS tracking feature.

Berdasarkan laporan, open settings by dragging the notification shade down twice, then tapping the gear icon (or tapping settings in the app drawer). For example, on my Pixel 9 Pro, it’s in Settings > Accessibility > Magnification. Where this is located depends on the Android version you’re using and your device. On a RedMagic 12 Pro, it’s in Settings > Features > Accessibility. If you don’t find it right away, open Settings and search for Magnification.

Berdasarkan laporan, once you’ve found the magnification option, tap the on/off slider until it’s in the on position, and the magnifier button will appear on your screen. Tap the button, and whatever is on the display will enlarge enough that you shouldn’t have any trouble reading it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, here’s a little tip: after tapping the magnification button, whatever’s been enlarged can be scrolled vertically, but not horizontally. Fortunately, there’s a way to ensure that you can read everything on the page.

Also: I use Google Magnifier to read tiny print without my glasses.

Berdasarkan laporan, tap the gear icon at the bottom right of the display to open the options pop-up. This enables a movable magnifier you can place where you need it (kind of like a traditional magnifying glass). On this page, tap the “Magnifier size” icon that’s second from the right. You can also change the size of the movable magnifier (by tapping one of the other “Magnifier size” buttons) as well as the size of the text when magnified (by dragging the bottom slider).

Also: RedMagic 12 Pro is the fastest Android phone I’ve ever seen.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this feature has alleviated the early-morning frustration of having to squint (even with my glasses on) to read certain news sites. Give it a try and see if it doesn’t make your Android life a bit clearer.

The company's founder steps down after reports of multiple affairs, and the AI industry faces unsettling questions.

Berdasarkan laporan, the company named colette kress, its chief financial officer, as interim ceo. Nvidia announced the news in a press release Thursday morning.

The removal of Huang as CEO follows the revelation over the weekend that Nvidia’s board of directors had opened an investigation into whether he had been targeted by foreign intelligence.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nvidia, which has at times in recent years been the world’s largest by market capitalization, now begins a search for a new permanent ceo. Huang, one of the company’s three co-founders, has served as president and CEO since Nvidia’s start in 1993. Harvey C. Its search for a permanent successor will include internal and external candidates, according to the press release. Jones, a former CEO of Synopsis, will serve as Nvidia’s first-ever chair of the board of directors.

Berdasarkan laporan, huang had been having an affair with alice huang (no relation), a chinese citizen and executive at megaspeed, a singapore-based data center company that buys chips from nvidia to run data centers that sell computing power to chinese ai labs. News reports citing US intelligence officials have claimed Alice Huang was working as a spy for China. She was reportedly under surveillance by US intelligence, as reported in late October by The New York Times.

Diungkapkan bahwa the information reported on tuesday that alice huang is believed to be involved with a network of chinese companies that facilitated the sales of $7. 5 billion in chips to China. The US has tried to control China’s access to advanced chips for years, but reports show that there are still illegal operations smuggling chips on the banned list from the US to China.

The New York Times also reported on Wednesday a separate affair between Huang and one of his direct reports at Nvidia.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the announcement of an investigation has rocked the ai chip behemoth, which makes the cutting-edge chips that power ai tools and ai data centers. A proposed class-action lawsuit was filed on Monday against Nvidia, charging the company made false or misleading statements about Huang’s affair and the company’s relationship with Megaspeed.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on tuesday, the nvidia board said it had retained joon h. Kim, a former acting US attorney for the Southern District of New York, and his firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to conduct an independent investigation.

Diungkapkan bahwa nvidia’s stock price opened at just over $150 per share thursday morning — half an hour after huang’s resignation was announced. That was down from where it closed Wednesday at nearly $174 per share. But the stock has been tumbling since October, when the price hit above $240, as it became apparent that political winds were turning against the AI industry and its vast data centers filled with Nvidia chips.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, markets turned against ai stocks last week after democrats secured huge gains in congress and in the governors offices of key data center states, like texas and ohio. The news around Huang and his resignation will further test AI’s clout on Wall Street.

Diungkapkan bahwa huang has been a prominent voice cheerleading the growth of ai. Nvidia has sold the picks and shovels for the AI gold rush — powerful GPUs and supercomputers capable of the complex computations needed to train and operate models. Trump spoke up in defense of Huang earlier this week, saying he knows Huang and thinks he’s an “honorable man. He became a close ally of President Donald Trump in the past two years, even taking a call from the president on stage during a podcast taping. ”.

Huang’s resignation and the scandal surrounding it pose serious questions not just for Nvidia but for all of the companies connected to it, from data center operators to AI developers and more, who have benefited from Nvidia’s financial support and investment.

Diungkapkan bahwa “the sudden resignation of jensen huang is about more than succession at the world’s most important ai chipmaker,” stephanie balaouras, vice president and group research director at the analyst firm forrester, said in an email. “Nvidia’s leadership crisis is a stress test for the AI boom. “.

Berdasarkan laporan, the company could quickly find stability under new leadership, balaouras said, but it may not. “If its stock, financing relationships, or ecosystem commitments remain under sustained pressure, that would add evidence to the fragile side of the AI Bubble ledger,” she said.

#165. Whoop just launched a social network

📅 12 Nov 2026

Whoop just launched a social network

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/whoop-just-launched-a-social-network/

Whoop, the maker of screen-less fitness bands, is launching a social network on Thursday that lets its members follow friends and family and share their health data.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the network, called whoop humans, will be rolled out in the whoop app to members at every membership tier at no extra cost. Followers can react and comment; members can also attach photos and commentary to their data. Members can follow anyone on Whoop and choose what to share, from sleep and recovery to workouts and achievements. It’s all opt-in, CEO Will Ahmed tells us.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, whoop already has a social feature, teams, which a little more than half its customers use, according to the company. Humans is meant to be more intimate. But Teams is built around groups and leaderboards, and everyone in a group sees everyone else’s information. Members decide who follows them and who sees what, so a trainer can track a set of clients without the clients seeing one another’s data, for example.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i found myself questioning how much a spouse wants to know about the other’s sleep score when ahmed mentioned this particular scenario, so i asked him how else beta members used these newer social features. He said the company learned that people were more engaged when someone reported a low recovery score than a nearly perfect one, suggesting that the new feature may be particularly helpful for understanding when someone is struggling and might need attention.

Berdasarkan laporan, indeed, the bigger story here is where whoop continues to be headed, which is into medical wellness. Like its most direct rival, Oura, the company is pushing faster and more aggressively into the wellness opportunity that an aging population presents.

Diungkapkan bahwa whoop had already added fda-cleared ecg and atrial fibrillation detection, blood pressure insights, blood testing, and medical-record uploads. Asked if older customers are gravitating to Whoop, Ahmed said, without offering specifics, that Whoop has seen “huge growth” among people over 60 over the past 18 months. He also said his was among the first companies accepted into a Medicare program that reimburses qualifying wearables that can show they improve health outcomes, and that it now has Medicare members.

Diungkapkan bahwa he added that he expects families to be big users of humans. (You can imagine adult children checking in on aging parents. ).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but the company’s efforts to be thought of as the “brand for personal health” raises questions, naturally, about privacy. Activities marked sensitive aren’t shared by default, and Ahmed said health alerts and medical information aren’t shared at all. Ahmed said members choose which metrics to share, can remove followers, and can switch on “stealth mode” to go dark for a few days without changing their settings. Members can also report any comment or photo that they deem disturbing, and the company said reported content is reviewed.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as for minors, whoop’s minimum age is 13 for all members (higher in some countries), meaning customers of that age can share their data subject to consents and privacy settings. Asked whether a parent could follow a teenager’s data, he didn’t answer directly and pointed to the privacy controls.

Diungkapkan bahwa ahmed also said whoop doesn’t sell member data. “Our product is not you; it’s the membership,” he said, adding that the company doesn’t license data to third parties.

Berdasarkan laporan, he was candid about dealmaking. Its deep relationship with members, he said, puts it “in a position to be an acquirer. Asked about Oura’s announcement this week that it will pay $625 million for Counsel Health, a service offering on-demand physicians, Ahmed said he expects “more consolidation” among AI-focused, clinician-focused, and wearable companies, and that Whoop is always on the prowl. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, he was more guarded about the company’s own finances, declining to share revenue or say whether whoop is profitable. He did say that the company now has about 1,200 employees, membership on its software platform has increased more than 70% a year for three years running, and that it expects to have nearly 4 million members by year-end.

Berdasarkan laporan, as for an ipo (the company raised a very big round earlier this year), he said only that whoop “will certainly ipo in the future. ” He also wouldn’t comment on Oura, which shelved its own IPO of up to $2. 2 billion in September citing market uncertainty.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the meantime, whoop is widening its reach. The company announced that its devices will be sold through Ulta stores beginning next March (around 500 locations of the beauty retailer to start, and a target to retail in more than a thousand stores eventually). Indeed, Ahmed said Whoop’s female audience has more than doubled from last year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as for competition, in addition to google’s new fitbit air band, whoop may soon have to contend with apple, which is reportedly developing a whoop-style band. But Ahmed mostly shrugged off those concerns, suggesting that building a product doesn’t guarantee success. Instead, he said, Whoop’s job is to stay true to the “aspiring” people it serves.

Diungkapkan bahwa there were discrepancies in the fitness data compared to other fitness trackers, and there was occasional missing data when tracking sleep and overall health. The watch face was also far too large for my wrist. To find out more, keep reading this full CMF Watch Pro review.

Accelerometer, heart rate monitor, blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) sensor.

Diungkapkan bahwa the cmf watch pro is available to purchase from the third-party retailer aliexpress in the u. for $123 and in the U. for £109. S. K. The watch is available in four colors, including Dark Grey, Ash Grey, Silver and Orange.

Diungkapkan bahwa the watch launched in september 2023 and has previously been available for as low as $69. However, it’s no longer available for purchase from Amazon or Nothing’s website, and its price has nearly doubled, so I wouldn’t recommend purchasing it anymore.

Diungkapkan bahwa you can get the newer cmf watch 3 pro for the much lower price of $79, and it has more advanced features like dual-band gps and 131 sport modes. It also has a circular watch face, which in my opinion looks sleeker, instead of the square face of the CMF Watch Pro.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you just want to track wellness and don’t feel you need to look at a screen for your workout stats, the fitbit air is a great option for $99. This screen-free device can detect and track up to 100 sports and activities, and forgoes the distraction of a screen, which I personally love.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the amazfit bip 6 is cheaper at $79 and performs far better. Sleep tracking is more accurate on the Bip 6 in comparison to the CMF Watch Pro. The Bip 6 can also track a wider variety of workouts.

Diungkapkan bahwa cmf by nothing is well known for its quirky design ethos, but the cmf watch pro seems to be a simple ode to the apple watch. It’s the same size as the larger variant of the Apple Watch Series 11. 96-inch AMOLED touch-screen display, it feels very bulky on my wrist. With a square, 1. However, the CMF watch is nowhere near as chunky as the newer CMF Watch 3 Pro, which takes up more real estate on my arm.

Diungkapkan bahwa the cmf watch pro has an aluminum alloy frame case, and it feels very sturdy. I wouldn’t recommend purchasing a watch with anything less than this level of protection, as you want it to be able to carry you through every activity. The watch is very durable, with a rating of IP68, meaning it is completely dust-tight and can be submerged underwater. With that said, it’s not the best you can get. It took a few bumps while I was carrying out my daily tasks, but there are no scratches at all. Other watches such as the Amazfit Bip 6 have a durability rating of 5ATM which means it can withstand underwater pressure, making it far better for sports.

Diungkapkan bahwa there is a button on the right side, which cycles through watch settings, but it’s also touchscreen. The adjustable silicone wrist strap feels secure throughout workouts and didn’t cause any irritation.

Diungkapkan bahwa the cmf watch pro can track up to 110 different sports. It has basic workouts like running, walking, weight training, and Pilates.

Berdasarkan laporan, it counts my daily steps, tracks my heart rate throughout activities, and has smart detection to automatically recognise some activities. You can also sync the data it collects with third-party apps like Strava and Apple Health, but you can’t integrate these apps into the watch.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, my average heart rate after each workout i measured was around the same as my oura ring 5, so i’d say the watch’s tracking here is pretty accurate. However, I noticed that my peak heart rate wasn’t the same — the CMF Watch Pro logged it a lot lower— and I logged around 700 steps less than my Oura Ring and phone each day. It’s a good-enough watch if you only need the very basics, but why not just purchase something similarly-priced with a bit more accuracy? I’d recommend the Amazfit Bip 6 or the Xiaomi Smart Band 10 for monitoring during workouts with more accuracy.

Health monitoring and sleep tracking are very basic on the CMF Watch Pro, and there are some discrepancies when compared to other devices, so this probably isn’t the best option for fitness fanatics.

Berdasarkan laporan, the cmf watch pro’s health tracking capabilities are basic. The step counts were inaccurate when compared to my Oura Ring and my peak heart rate wasn’t always captured. It can also track your stress. If you want this you’ll have to spend more on the Apple Watch Series 11. There’s 24-hour heart rate tracking and blood oxygen monitoring, but no ECG. These are important metrics if you’re managing a health condition, however there was missing data and discrepancies during activity when compared to other tracking devices. I also experienced this issue when using the CMF Watch 3 Pro.

Diungkapkan bahwa you can also set up reminders on the watch for hydration and standing up. I personally like the stand-up reminder; I sometimes need a nudge to take a stretch break.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, interestingly, sleep tracking on the cmf watch pro is more accurate than the cmf watch 3 pro. The CMF Watch Pro tracked my full sleep; however, it was unbroken, whereas my Oura Ring picked up some accurate wake times.

Berdasarkan laporan, i found the sleep analysis in the nothing x app very basic. Since I like to track my sleep to evaluate readiness to account for my training load, having more information about movement and getting feedback on readings is often very helpful. If that’s something you want, the Xiaomi Smart Band 10 is a great option for $51.

Diungkapkan bahwa the cmf watch pro gets up to 13 days of battery life per charge, but heavy use decreases this to around 11 days, which is still impressive. It took an hour to fully charge. It has the same battery life rating as the CMF Watch 3 Pro, and the more I consider the two devices, there’s not much separating them apart from their shape and an upgraded GPS system.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when the cmf watch pro is in power-saving mode, you can get up to 45 days of use. This obviously limits what you can do and won’t track your metrics continuously, and at that point you may as well just have an analog watch on your wrist.

Berdasarkan laporan, the cmf watch pro is a solid option for anyone buying their first smartwatch. More advanced watches can seem overwhelming; this is a great entry-level option with 110 tracking modes and a secure and reliable fit. The battery can last almost two weeks, and the IP68 rating means it’s ready for anything, so you don’t need to take it off.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, the large face of the cmf watch pro wasn’t the best fit for my wrist and led to some missing data and discrepancies in my fitness tracking compared to other watches. you may as well buy the newer CMF Watch 3 Pro, as there’s not that much difference between the two, and weirdly, the new watch is cheaper.

#169. Google pushes privacy angle as Gemini-powered smartglasses debut starting at $395

📅 12 Nov 2026

Google pushes privacy angle as Gemini-powered smartglasses debut starting at $395

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://arstechnica.com/google/2026/11/google-pushes-privacy-angle-as-gemini-powered-smartglasses-debut-starting-at-395/

The first Gemini smartglasses are a collab between Google, Samsung, Gentle Monster, and Warby Parker.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, smartglasses have always faced an uphill road to acceptance. Now, Google is ready to take another swing at “intelligent eyewear” for the Gemini era after previewing its plans a couple of times. Not only is propping a computer up on your nose an uncomfortable proposition, but the privacy aspect has been vexing people since the Google Glass days. The first glasses are up for preorder today from Gentle Monster and Warby Parker, but they’re no impulse buy.

Diungkapkan bahwa these devices are a collaboration between google, samsung, and the aforementioned eyewear designers. Gentle Monster and Warby Parker have each designed a few different frames, with options for transparent and tinted lenses. Samsung is providing the computing hardware that fits inside them, and Google has the software covered.

Diungkapkan bahwa warby parker has designed three frames for google eyewear, called alden, reid, and wren (see above). They are available with both standard optical and sun lenses in Pine, Saddle, and Jet Black colors at $395 and higher. Gentle Monster has gone a bit further with six styles, but Google hasn’t told us any names for those yet. They come in dark red, pink, gray, and yellow colors and are available with clear, tinted, blue, or brown lenses. Warby Parker is only selling devices in the US. The Gentle Monster styles start a little higher at $449, and they will be available in the US and South Korea.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, google says the frames all weigh about 41 grams, which is not terrible but is definitely near the top for glasses generally. That will also determine the final pricing. They will, naturally, weigh much more when you account for lenses. So far, we only have the starting prices for these devices, including non-prescription lenses.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the setup here is similar to the ray-ban meta glasses we’ve seen for a few years. There are no screens in the lenses, but you can interact with the AI system via voice or by activating the integrated camera. The experience should be similar to using Gemini Live on your phone, but it will be a lot easier to fire up the AI. You can say “Hey Gemini” or tap a touch-sensitive area of the frame to start interacting with the robot.

Credit: Gentle Monster Credit: Gentle Monster.

Sebagaimana diketahui, since this is the same chatbot that operates across the google ecosystem, it has access to your data and preferences. You can ask questions and get personalized answers, have Google Maps guide you by voice, or just talk with the AI to kill time. The glasses use custom open-ear speakers to limit distractions for those around you. Google notes the directional microphones should not pick up speech from other people, either.

Diungkapkan bahwa adding the camera feed is where things get interesting. Google suggests asking Gemini for recommendations when looking at a bookshelf or glancing at an event poster to have the AI add it to your calendar. When the AI can see what you see, it has the potential to do more work on your behalf. The glasses will also support Gemini Guided Vision, which provides conversational audio descriptions for people who are visually impaired.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the utility of these devices hinges on gemini. The chatbot still regularly screws up simple things like adding calendar appointments or identifying objects in an image in my testing, and when you don’t have a screen to verify the AI’s output, it may be harder to trust it. I would be remiss not to point out that Gemini, like all AI systems, is not infallible. In fact, it can be frustratingly fallible at times. These devices will really only make sense if you can rely on Gemini to do things right, and that’s still not a guarantee.

Berdasarkan laporan, all the gemini-powered glasses from gentle monster and warby parker feature a 12 mp wide-angle camera capable of shooting photos and video. Google says it has implemented a number of features and limitations to ensure people don’t do creepy things with its intelligent eyewear, and that it doesn’t do creepy things to you—Google claims its approach respects privacy on “both sides of the lens. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for starters, there’s a recording light that is on whenever the camera is active. In that event, the glasses will refuse to activate the camera. Like the Meta glasses, Google’s eyewear will detect if the light has been covered up or modified in any way that would prevent it from illuminating. All Google-powered glasses will have a physical off switch, too.

Credit: Warby Parker Credit: Warby Parker.

Diungkapkan bahwa on the user privacy side, google says it will not save any images or videos captured by the glasses in your gemini history. Additionally, none of that data will be used for training AI models or targeting ads. Your voice interactions with Gemini via the glasses are, as with all other Gemini endpoints, not guaranteed the same level of protection. You can delete your chats from the Gemini history, though.

Diungkapkan bahwa data on the glasses is encrypted, and it remains that way during transit to the cloud. However, it’s not encrypted on Google’s servers. The company does note that it’s working to bring Private AI Compute to glasses, which will isolate data during processing so not even Google can access it.

Credit: Gentle Monster Credit: Gentle Monster.

Berdasarkan laporan, anyone looking to get gemini on their face and test google’s privacy promise can preorder the glasses from the gentle monster and warby parker websites. Devices should ship and appear on store shelves on December 10. Importantly, support for these devices is a bit narrow at launch. They will work with all iPhones from the 13 Pro onward. On the Android side, you’ll need a Pixel 7 or newer or a Samsung Galaxy S or Z series device running One UI 9 or later. If you’ve got a cheaper Samsung Galaxy or a device from another OEM, you’re out of luck at the moment.

#172. You Can Get Google’s New Smart Glasses Next Month. I’ve Tried Them Out

📅 12 Nov 2026

You Can Get Google’s New Smart Glasses Next Month. I’ve Tried Them Out

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnet.com/tech/mobile/google-samsung-intelligent-eyewear-warby-parker-gentle-monster-launch-date-hands-on/

Our gifting experts are obsessively searching for holiday gifts that are unique, thoughtful and suitable for any budget.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, our expert, award-winning staff selects the products we cover and rigorously researches and tests our top picks. If you buy through our links, we may earn a commission.

Warby Parker's and Gentle Monster's Google and Samsung-created smart glasses have cameras like Meta's, but these have some subtle differences when it comes to AI.

Berdasarkan laporan, in gentle monster’s hallucinatory showroom, i stared up at four robotic heads turning and talking inside floating spheres. I listened to them speak different languages. All of them were translated in my ears, on the fly, as I wore a pair of Gentle Monster smart glasses — “Intelligent Eyewear” codeveloped by Google and Samsung that will finally arrive Dec. 10.

They’ll be Google’s first pair of smart glasses since its Google Glass days more than a decade ago, and they’re landing at a time when public opinions on AI, smart glasses and data privacy couldn’t be more heated.

Berdasarkan laporan, google’s return to smart glasses has been promised for nearly two years, but the first waves of actual prescription-ready eyewear are only now rolling in nearly at year’s end, an unusual time for a product launch. Really, it feels more like a kickoff for efforts that will continue next year, as Google also works on AI-enabled glasses that have displays built in.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i’d worn google and samsung’s smart glasses in multiple demos before, but this month for the first time i got to try on and test the final versions designed by warby parker and gentle monster. I also visited two immersive showrooms the companies are opening in New York City to demo how these glasses work. These showrooms will be open by appointment.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the showrooms were like playgrounds, full of installation art to try the glasses in. Warby’s space was a series of library-themed rooms, with travel themes and whimsical sculptures. Gentle Monster’s was a stark, surreal series of rooms, blending industrial design and realistic (sometimes robotic) horses, people, chickens, floating heads and… a big blue gentle monster.

The glasses I wore gave me a strong sense of deja vu after years of reviewing Meta smart glasses and lots of others, but there are also signs of how their deeper-connected Gemini smarts could be a big difference-maker — and likely a sign of how Apple might approach its own glasses expected in 2027.

Berdasarkan laporan, the various models of smart glasses across warby parker and gentle monster designs, which start at $395 and $449 respectively, all work the same: the frames do not have displays, just standard glasses lenses that support a range of prescriptions and lens types that match what warby and gentle monster already offer. They have speakers on the arms that project audio, along with four beamforming microphones that filter out background noise and focus on the direction you’re facing. They have a single camera on the left side, and an LED light indicator on the right.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i got to try on all the frame designs and then wore frames with my prescription lenses popped in so that i could actually use the glasses around the exhibits. The glasses feel reminiscent of what Meta’s made for years, with a similar frame size and arm length to recent Ray-Ban Gen 3 models. Most of the frames weigh around 40 grams, which felt pretty easy on my face, but I wear chunky glasses to begin with.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and the frame designs, while mostly clean and somewhat conservative, all looked really good. Warby Parker’s collection of designs came in several understated color shades (I liked the dark green pine the best), and familiar round and square frames.

All of the Intelligent Eyewear models across both brands have cameras, a feature that Google’s head of XR, Shahram Izadi, still sees as key to having a deep assistive experience, although he’s also open to the idea of future versions that could be camera-free like Meta’s recent Ray-Ban Audio model.

Cameras have been a big flashpoint in smart glasses over the past year, with concerns over harassment and privacy, certain countries and businesses banning them and worries about them being socially inappropriate.

These glasses use the same type of indicator system as Meta’s glasses do, flashing an LED that also auto-adjusts brightness outdoors and playing a sound when taking photos and videos.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i was particularly impressed by how gemini can just listen to any snippet of speech and translate it into the language you need, a trick that makes these glasses feel like a swiss army knife for travel. Several demos showcased this, including the surreal room of robotic heads that discussed Gentle Monster’s design philosophy in a handful of languages. I heard them all, sometimes with a short delay or hiccup, over 10 minutes or so.

Diungkapkan bahwa the glasses can recognize written languages, too, in a much larger range than i’m used to: over 70. Live translation kicks in when you press and hold two fingers on the glasses’ temple, and the translated voices adjust to match different speakers in a room and varied intonation.

Sebagaimana diketahui, pressing and holding the side temple turns on gemini, and once it’s on, it stays on until a significant pause of about 15 seconds or so. That meant that I could keep chatting and asking questions without asking, “Hey Google,” (or, “Hey Gemini,” a new trigger phrase). I could end a session by swiping backward on the arm.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, any of the chats i have can also be turned into a note or summary instantly, hooking into google keep. The glasses connect with Google Maps, and Izadi promises that most of Gemini’s key features on phones will carry over to the glasses. On iPhones, the glasses will be able to triangulate across Google apps via the cloud to access Gmail, calendars and more.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i found a few clever demos that showed me some promise. I could point to things and casually ask, “What is this?” and Gemini knew what I was referring to. In a pantry installation full of world foods in Gentle Monster’s showroom, I asked Gemini to compare brands of international mayo in front of me. In another demo, Gemini knew the sheet music I was holding up and played back the matching song. In another demo, I sat down and gave myself a tarot card reading — Gemini could read the cards, regardless of whether the cards were right-side up or reversed.

Diungkapkan bahwa other times, gemini said the text i asked it to read was too far away, even though i could read it on a wall. (It responded with “8 minutes” to a question on a wall about whether it was OK to wait 45 minutes for a restaurant table. Sometimes it seemed to hallucinate an odd answer to a question. ).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, tapping the temple arm starts and stops music, swiping changes tracks and two-finger swipes change volume (which was a bit confusing). Meanwhile, a top button on the arm takes photos and videos just like Meta glasses do, but in some demo sessions, it seemed like photos got beamed over to a Pixel phone much faster than they do to Meta’s app.

Berdasarkan laporan, the music playback sounded good based on some quick tries in a crowded room. The audio seemed particularly loud, maybe even a bit more so than Meta’s glasses, but I’ll know more about that when I review them.

Berdasarkan laporan, the real test of google’s intelligent eyewear is in how truly well connected those ai services feel and in the battery life. Meta promises up to eight hours of battery life on the Scriber Optics glasses I’ve been wearing the last few months, but the battery drains faster than that in heavy use. Will Google manage battery better, or similarly?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s the ai features and google app hook-ins that could give google a leg up. My several hours wearing pairs and wandering through two different immersive public installation spaces only showed me hints, and really, I’m most curious about how the glasses can tap into my entire Gemini history, my Gmail, my Google Docs, or my Google Maps history. How smart and connected can they be, and how good (or unsettling) will that feel?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for now, google’s approach to privacy on its services for these ai glasses has the best chance of standing apart. Always-on Gemini modes with camera don’t share any photos or videos for AI training or for targeting ads, and none of the camera captures in AI modes can be seen or shared by the wearer or Google, either. Cameras are standard for this first wave of glasses, but Gemini treats camera feeds in AI mode differently than how photos and videos are taken otherwise, Google’s Juston Payne, senior director of project management for XR, told me. Faces are autoredacted using AI on your connected phone before being sent to the cloud for AI analysis, Payne says.

That’s encouraging, but Google’s already raising questions of AI privacy with targeted ads in Gemini-powered Google search on phones and computers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, google’s also not enabling any livestreaming from these glasses, a move that leans careful compared to meta’s livestreaming modes on its glasses. “We’ll always take the conservative path right now just to rebuild trust,” Payne said.

Berdasarkan laporan, the glasses also won’t be able to continuously record audio ambiently to create memory summaries like apple’s new in-beta siri recap feature on its recent watches can or like other smart glasses sometimes do. Also, they don’t have any environmental listening features yet, something Google says is also privacy-focused, but music recognition and other audio awareness features are on the roadmap. In Gemini-based audio chats with AI, Google also scrubs out voices that might be chatting near you.

Berdasarkan laporan, but it remains to be seen how much any of this will help make anyone in public feel comfortable with someone wearing a pair of these glasses with camera-enabled ai modes on. It’s already hard to convince people that smart glasses aren’t recording people all the time, and Google’s clearly trying to restore confidence in the idea of smart glasses in public situations.

Berdasarkan laporan, the warby parker and gentle monster models are not the only new smart wearables google has coming: a pair of tethered mixed reality glasses that come with a processor puck and work almost like a portable vr headset, called xreal aura, is arriving in the next few weeks. And Google’s also starting to test its display-enabled Intelligent Eyewear ahead of a possible launch next year.

Sebagaimana diketahui, izadi also told me that more assistive features are coming to these camera-enabled glasses, including what google calls guided vision, something of an extension to the project astra tech google has been working on for years. “You’ll hear more about our plans in the coming months,” Izadi said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but agentic ai is clearly the road going forward, something both google and meta are expanding on for glasses. “We’ll bring more and more agentic and core AI features so that people can depend more on the AI capabilities,” Izadi said. Google’s leaning on these glasses being true phone extensions, as well as watch-connected.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but there could be a lot of cascading hardware pieces in between. Google and Samsung have already promised multiple waves of tethered and wireless smart glasses, ones with displays and ones without, and these glasses are apparently just the start.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i’m curious to see how well warby parker and gentle monster approach support for the glasses and how easy it’ll be to understand how they work. Dec. 10 isn’t far away.

#173. Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement?

📅 12 Nov 2026

Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement?

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/jensen-huang-is-out-at-nvidia-who-is-colette-kress-his-interim-replacement/

The Nvidia Board of Directors announced on Thursday morning that the company’s co-founder and CEO of 33 years, Jensen Huang, has resigned as president, CEO, and member of the board, effective immediately.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this is a shocking twist for one of the most valuable companies in the world, which designs the chips that make the ai boom possible. Few people would have predicted this turn of events even just a week ago, as Huang has been so central to Nvidia throughout the company’s existence that he never even established a succession plan. But Huang has now been ousted after reports that he had affairs with both an alleged Chinese spy and one of his direct reports at Nvidia.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while the company conducts a more thorough search for huang’s successor, nvidia cfo and executive vice president colette kress has taken over as interim ceo. But beyond her name and job title, what do we know about the person who will now lead a company worth about $3. 8 trillion?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, according to nvidia’s website, kress has worked at the company since september 2013. She also worked at Microsoft for 13 years, where she spent four years as CFO of the Server and Tools division. Before that, she spent three years as an SVP and CFO of Cisco’s Business Technology Operations Finance organization. She holds a finance degree from the University of Arizona and an MBA from Southern Methodist University.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the california-based 59-year-old has a very limited social media presence — on linkedin, she has commented some well wishes on former colleagues’ posts about their retirement. But as CFO, she’s been a regular presence on Nvidia’s earnings calls, making her a familiar figure for analysts covering the company.

Berdasarkan laporan, according to forbes’ list of america’s richest self-made women, kress’ net worth is estimated to be about $1. 2 billion. #174. Bitdefender Antivirus Plus Review: Undercutting the Competition

📅 13 Nov 2026

Bitdefender Antivirus Plus Review: Undercutting the Competition

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.wired.com/review/bitdefender-antivirus-plus/

Antivirus programs are a dime a dozen these days, and while the vast array of security threats that assail modern devices can at times feel so overwhelming that protection seems impossible, a good antivirus solution remains essential.

Berdasarkan laporan, unfortunately, purchasing an antivirus can prove rather confusing. If you dig deep enough into a company’s website, however, you’ll find that most still offer the option to purchase the antivirus with few add-ons at a lower price. Companies offer a huge range of bundles with long lists of features, many of which are obscured in vague language. And if that’s what you want, Bitdefender’s Antivirus Plus is a good option.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, buying bitdefender antivirus plus on its own is arguably a bit confusing, as the company strongly pushes shoppers toward more expensive and all-inclusive bitdefender bundles, which include other features like a password manager, dark web monitoring, and lots more. In total, there are four different bundles to choose from: Total Security, Premium Security, Ultimate Security, and Ultimate Security Plus Extended, ranging from $60 up to $140 for the first year. All these bundles include the same antivirus protection, but if you search for Antivirus Plus on its own, though, you will find it. There are also Family versions of these plans, which are more expensive but add protection for up to 25 devices and parental controls. And it’s arguably worth seeking out, as Bitdefender's entry-level options are priced most aggressively.

Berdasarkan laporan, bitdefender antivirus plus currently offers an introductory price of $25 for the first year (and $50 after) for a single device or $30 for the first year ($70 after) for three devices. This is quite a bit less than Bitdefender Total Security, which is $60 for the first year (and $110 after) and only offers two benefits in exchange: a password manager and protection for up to five devices instead of just one. The lower tiers tend to be better deals, especially if you're after something specific.

Diungkapkan bahwa that’s because bitdefender’s pricing is most competitive at its lowest tiers, which may by itself be enough reason for many to choose it. Rivals like Norton Antivirus Standard, McAfee Essential, Avira Internet Security, and Malwarebytes Standard typically ask more for a similar level of service.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there is some variation here; norton throws in a password manager at a lower price point, for instance, and some competitors have superior vpn service included (bitdefender antivirus plus limits you to 200 mb of vpn data per day, which isn’t much). Still, Bitdefender Antivirus Plus is among the more affordable options, particularly if you’re more interested in the antivirus than the add-ons.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, savvy users might balk at paying at all, as many free antivirus options exist. Bitdefender itself offers a free antivirus download for both Windows and Android (but not macOS, iOS, or iPadOS). This is a fair choice, though it often means you’ll have to tolerate advertisements urging you to sign up.

Berdasarkan laporan, buying, downloading, and installing bitdefender antivirus plus is a smooth experience. Once the installation is finished, Antivirus Plus automatically runs an initial virus check. The payment portal is straightforward. The installer is really a downloader, so it’s a small file; the full download required by the installer is roughly 800 megabytes. This took less than five minutes on a Microsoft Surface Laptop 7 running Windows 11.

Berdasarkan laporan, once installed, the bitdefender antivirus plus interface provides a default dashboard that includes several common actions, including a quick scan, total system scan, and vulnerability scan (the latter looks for problems like a weak account password or an overly permissive network configuration). You’ll also find an option to turn on Bitdefender VPN, which is installed alongside the antivirus—though, as mentioned, you’re limited to 200 MB of data per day unless you upgrade to Bitdefender Premium VPN.

Berdasarkan laporan, these features are largely standard for an antivirus program, though one extra feature requires more explanation: safepay. I don’t believe these are the most common avenues cybercriminals use to obtain payment information; they’re far more likely to buy huge repositories of payment data stolen from compromised companies. To be honest, I’m doubtful of the feature’s utility. This creates a sandboxed browsing environment meant to thwart threats like keyloggers and man-in-the-middle attacks. It’s also rather clunky to launch Safepay for an online purchase, so I don’t think most people will want to use it.

Diungkapkan bahwa i spent most of my time using bitdefender antivirus plus on windows, which i think is the best version of the software. However, macOS is the odd one out with an interface that looks different from its peers and, to my eyes, seems about five years out of date. The Android and iOS versions look largely similar to it, though of course compressed for a mobile device. It’s not terrible and has similar functionality, but I find this a bit odd. It seems like the macOS software is missing a software refresh that other platforms received.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a nice software interface is a perk but, at its core, antivirus software is supposed to stop viruses and other malware. So, how does Bitdefender Antivirus Plus rank?.

Berdasarkan laporan, bitdefender scored well in av-test’s latest report, where it detected 100 percent of the tested attacks and received an av-test top product certification. 5 percent of threats, enough to earn it the top three-star score. It also received high marks from AV-Comparatives, which found it detected 99. Bitdefender’s consumer products weren’t ranked in the latest SE Labs consumer antivirus report, but the small-business product detected 99 percent of threats and received an AAA ranking in the April 2026 report.

Berdasarkan laporan, the performance hit from bitdefender antivirus plus wasn’t noticeable in typical use of either my windows 11 laptop or my apple macbook air m4. Bitdefender services consumed about 700 MB of memory in total on both platforms. That’s not a lot, and it's in line with what I often see from antivirus programs, though it’s also not trivial. I can imagine this could at times result in a performance hit on a device with 8 GB of RAM. My devices have 32 GB and 24 GB, respectively, however, so I didn’t encounter any issues.

Berdasarkan laporan, bitdefender antivirus plus checks off most boxes for an antivirus program. It’s affordable, easy to use, earns high marks from malware testing labs, and avoids significant performance issues when installed. But I do want to return to a problem I’ve mentioned before: the VPN.

Diungkapkan bahwa antivirus plus advertises an included vpn. The service has a strict 200-MB (per day, per device) data cap, which isn’t going to be enough if you want to use it as your main VPN. This is true, but it’s actually the free VPN service that anyone can obtain. To be fair, Bitdefender does detail this limitation on its website—but it does seem like an added feature when, in reality, it’s available for free whether you buy Antivirus Plus or not.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that could steer you away from bitdefender if you want an antivirus and vpn. Competitors like Norton and McAfee bundle an unlimited VPN service into lower tiers of service, which, though more expensive than Bitdefender Antivirus Plus, are less expensive than Bitdefender Antivirus Plus and Bitdefender Premium VPN combined.

Unfortunate VPN bundling aside, Bitdefender Antivirus Plus is a good choice if you want antivirus for Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS.

Diungkapkan bahwa it’s particularly competitive if you just want the antivirus protection on its own. But there are plenty of reasons to just go for the antivirus itself (for example, credit and dark web monitoring features might already be available through your bank or another institution). All of the major cybersecurity companies would really prefer it if you bought a bundle (including Bitdefender), and they’re often good value if you actually use all the features. And if antivirus protection is all you want, Bitdefender Antivirus Plus is a superb choice.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, bitdefender’s advantage is quite simple. It provides antivirus protection that detects most threats at a price that often undercuts the competition. It’s hard to think of a reason to pay more for an alternative when Bitdefender does the job well for as little as $25 for the first year.

Berdasarkan laporan, you should update your devices now, as several generations are affected across device categories. The following software versions include patches:.

Berdasarkan laporan, another issue in messages could allow an authorized added member to access messages within a group chat that were sent before they joined. According to Apple, the code that caused this issue has been removed.

Diungkapkan bahwa another vulnerability pertains to airplay, allowing an attacker within bluetooth range or on the same network to bypass the rate limit on airplay pairing code attempts. This issue also affects iOS, iPadOS, MacOS, VisionOS, and WatchOS.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this vulnerability is similar to the airborne attack method. This report, published in 2025 by Oligo, describes how zero-click remote code execution, user-interaction bypass, denial-of-service, man-in-the-middle, and other techniques can be used to take control of a device that supports AirPlay.

However, the current security issue is likely less serious or far-reaching and was discovered internally.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for this issue, when you pair a device with an airplay receiver, such as an apple tv, airplay-enabled tv, or mac, it will prompt you for a security pin to verify your device. You can only input an incorrect PIN a certain number of times before you’re denied pairing for a period of time.

Also: The new Apple TV 4K is always listening for ‘Hey Siri’.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a vulnerability in this defense mechanism can allow an attacker within bluetooth range of, or on the same network as, your device to use a brute-force attack, bypassing the mechanism that limits the number of incorrect pin attempts, and eventually gain access to your device. There are only so many PIN combinations.

According to Apple, “a logic issue was addressed with improved state management” to fix this problem.

SpaceX will try to catch both halves of its giant Starship in one launch, grabbing the booster minutes after liftoff and the ship nearly a full day later.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, no one has pulled off such a feat before. If both attempts work, the company says it will become the first to recover an entire orbital rocket for reuse. SpaceX has caught its Super Heavy booster three times before, but it has never tried to catch the the ship — the part that actually reaches orbit — until now.

Diungkapkan bahwa this test, known as flight 15, seeks to make a leap in progress and could launch as soon as friday, nov. Starship's flight 14 test was the first to enter orbit, but controllers cut its planned nine-hour mission short. 13. This time, SpaceX wants the ship to stay in space for about 22 ½ hours and land both pieces back at its Starbase launch site in South Texas, where huge mechanical arms will be waiting to snatch them out of the air.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the stakes reach far beyond texas. To get there, Starship must refuel in orbit, which takes a series of fuel-hauling launches. NASA is counting on Starship as one of two lunar landers, along with Blue Origin's Blue Moon, to put astronauts on the moon as soon as 2028. SpaceX can only fly that often if it reuses its rockets the way airlines reuse jets. China, meanwhile, aims to land its own crew on the moon before 2030. And while SpaceX juggles the NASA contract, founder Elon Musk is laser-focused on his personal ambition of getting the rocket and ship ready to carry people to Mars and build a city there.

Berdasarkan laporan, if starship lifts off when the launch window opens at 5:45 p. CT Saturday. ET / 4:15 p. ET / 4:45 p. m. SpaceX will livestream the flight on its website and X, starting around 5:15 p. ET / 3:18 p. m. m. m. m. m. CT Friday, the final ship catch after reentry into the atmosphere would happen around 4:18 p. CT Friday, or about 30 minutes before liftoff.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this spaceflight will stress starship like never before. It will fly for about 21 hours until its path lines up with Starbase. The ship will circle Earth about 14 times and release 26 new Starlink internet satellites. Then, its engines must fire again to bring it home.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "relying on this engine to get us there for that final one percent of a historic return-to-launch-site mission is pretty scary," said lars blackmore, senior principal mars landing engineer, in a new company video, "go for orbit. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the trip back to earth brings a new kind of risk. This time, the ship will cross parts of northern Mexico and southern Texas, steering around the region's larger cities. Every earlier Starship ended its flight with a splashdown in open ocean. People in and around Cameron County may hear sonic booms, the loud bangs a vehicle makes when it outruns the speed of sound.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but things might not work out as planned. If anything looks wrong, they can ditch the ship in the ocean instead. Controllers will only bring the ship home if it passes a set of FAA-approved health checks. SpaceX built into the timeline ways to bail out near Hawaii and off the coast of Chile.

The video shared in the above X post is an animation of what the Starship catch should look like during flight test 15 if all goes as planned.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the september test showed why those backup plans matter. During the climb to space, one of the ship's engines shut down early. The team first called off the trip to orbit, then pressed ahead, apparently after Musk questioned the conservative decision.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "we had thought, like, 'hey, let's not proceed if anything goes wrong,'" said jeremy pedro, director of starship engineering, in the video. "And Elon really questioned the requirements and asked us, 'Is there anything actually prohibiting us from going forward?'".

The ship successfully released all of its satellites, but controllers brought it down early near Hawaii.

Berdasarkan laporan, "on launch day, we get risks from the engine team, from avionics, from the computers, from the propulsion system, from all the plumbing on the rocket. We get risks from the launch pad. We get risks from the tower and the catch arms," said Shana Diez, director of Starship engineering, in the video. "But the goal is always to take the risk in the place where you can learn the most, and that's the calculus that we're doing every day. ".

With the aim of securing other vital systems, Google DeepMind plans to open-source its AlphaProof Code.

Berdasarkan laporan, researchers at google deepmind used ai to formally verify portions of signal‘s underlying code — meaning they’ve mathematically proven that at least parts of the encrypted messaging app’s code do what they say, without errors. That’s reassuring given how many vulnerabilities AI systems have discovered in software lately, and how many people’s communications are protected by Signal’s cryptography. WhatsApp and Google Messages use the same encryption.

Also: How AI security failures are endangering your supply chain.

Berdasarkan laporan, deepmind used alphaproof code, “a novel agentic framework for formal verification at unprecedented depth that combines human expertise with ai agents,” the researchers said. They added that formal verification “is the highest standard of security assurance,” but, without automation at scale like AI systems, difficult and time-consuming.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ai companies like openai have been on a math-breakthrough tear as of late, in some cases solving nearly century-old math problems with ai. By computing at such vast scale, AI models can rapidly accelerate much of the manual work mathematicians do.

Berdasarkan laporan, (disclosure: ziff davis, zdnet’s parent company, filed an april 2025 lawsuit against openai, alleging it infringed ziff davis copyrights in training and operating its ai systems. ).

Diungkapkan bahwa using alphaproof code and building on earlier verification work by the signal foundation, deepmind researchers divided the verification task into two camps. Humans worked with agents to identify what they needed to prove, and multiple agents running Gemini Carbon, the company’s latest model, then executed it. The agents also audited the proof and “highlighted areas that needed a second look by a human — just 1% of the codebase, a massive time savings,” the researchers wrote.

Also: After the vibe-coding rush comes the debugging hangover.

For good measure, researchers tested AlphaProof Code’s ability to distinguish correct from flawed code by showing it two previously fixed Signal bugs, for which it produced correct proofs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “our work marks the first time ai has been used to formally verify a widely deployed cryptographic protocol at this depth,” the researchers wrote. “It’s also the first time the implementation of a widely deployed protocol like this has been formally verified by any method, with or without AI. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, normally, researchers need to manually develop a proof to verify software, which takes much longer. That labor-intensive barrier has made formal verification a distant promised land, until now. The DeepMind team’s verification took a month to do what might normally take experts years.

DeepMind did not verify all of Signal’s code, but noted that this test is a step toward improved security infrastructure at a time when AI is disrupting the entire cybersecurity space.

Also: How to encrypt emails in Gmail, Outlook, and more.

“Having the core Signal protocol rigorously verified with automated theorem proving gives us even greater confidence that our code delivers on its privacy guarantees,” the researchers wrote.

Diungkapkan bahwa the breakthrough reiterates how deeply ai is both a massive risk for cybersecurity and an equally powerful fix. The year 2026 has been especially marked by AI-related security incidents, many of which involve agents.
