Show HN: My $300 embroidery machine needed a subscription, so I built my own app

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://github.com/simpsoka/zigzag

Sebagaimana diketahui, free, open-source embroidery software for mac and windows. Turn SVG artwork into machine embroidery, edit stitches visually, and create designs with AI agents via MCP.

Diungkapkan bahwa zigzag is a visual embroidery editor built in rust for performance, with built-in mcp (model context protocol) support so ai agents can create and edit designs alongside you. Turn SVG artwork into stitches, fine-tune it in the editor, and export PES, DST, EXP, JEF, or VP3 for broad compatibility with embroidery machines—or send designs directly to a Brother Skitch (PP1) over Bluetooth.

Sebagaimana diketahui, draw in illustrator, draw in zigzag, or let an agent draw. The Rust engine and zigzag command-line tool power the same workflow outside the editor.

Download the video (MP4, 1080p) · Original post on X.

Diungkapkan bahwa for apple silicon and intel macs, macos 11 or later. Open the DMG, then drag ZigZag into Applications. The release is signed and notarized by Apple. No Rust installation is needed.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, download zigzag for windows — the zigzag--x86_64-windows. zip asset on the latest release.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for 64-bit windows 10 (version 1709 or later) and windows 11. exe. Windows SmartScreen warns on apps without a Microsoft-trusted signature the first time they run; click More info → Run anyway. Unzip it and double-click ZigZag. No Rust installation is needed.

Release notes and checksums · Changelog · Publishing a release.

Sebagaimana diketahui, linux needs the usual x11/wayland and opengl dev libraries for gui. libdbus is vendored for ble.

Satins wider than 7 mm are auto-split (shorter, staggered stitches) and use auto spacing (narrow columns more open, wide ones denser).

On a Mac with Rust and the Xcode command line tools (xcode-select --install):.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, --release signs with your developer id and has apple notarize the app and the dmg, so it opens on any mac without warnings. apple. Once, beforehand: add a Developer ID Application certificate (Xcode › Settings › Accounts › Manage Certificates › +), make an app-specific password at account. com, and save the notarization credentials in your keychain:.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the app bundles the studio, the zigzag command-line tool and the mcp bridge. For Claude Desktop, point the MCP config at /Applications/ZigZag. To use the command line from anywhere: ln -s /Applications/ZigZag. app/Contents/MacOS/zigzag /usr/local/bin/zigzag. app/Contents/MacOS/zigzag-mcp.

Sebagaimana diketahui, without --release the app is signed ad hoc, not notarized. It opens normally on the Mac that built it. On another Mac, macOS blocks it the first time: open System Settings › Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway (on macOS 14 and earlier, right-click the app and choose Open instead). macOS asks for Bluetooth permission the first time you send to the Skitch.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the approved embroidered icons live in packaging/macos/appicon. The Mac build regenerates both multi-resolution. icns files; run bash packaging/macos/make-icons. Finder and the unopened app use the light icon. png (light) and packaging/macos/AppIcon-dark. sh to regenerate them separately. png (dark). While the studio is running, its Dock icon follows the app's light/dark theme, including the ZIGZAG_THEME=light|dark override.

Laid out like Illustrator, styled like a Mac app:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, tools down the left edge: select (v), direct selection (a), hand (h), pen (p): click for corners, drag for curves (option breaks the handles, shift keeps 45°, space moves the point being placed); while drawing, option lends it the anchor point tool (drag a segment to bend it, a handle to move it alone, click a smooth point for a corner) and ⌘ lends direct selection (drag a point or handle, then keep drawing), and on a selected path option-drag bends a segment too. Shapes (M rectangle, L ellipse, \ line; hold or right-click for polygon and star), Fill Angle (G), Measure (I), Text (T). Brush (B), with VectorCraft's path clean-up tools in its group: Smooth (drag along a path to take the wobble out: fewer points, smoother curves; Smoothness in the bar above), Path Eraser (drag across a path to cut that part away) and Join (scrub between two open ends to join them, or an open path's two ends to close it). Illustrator's Pen group is behind it: Add Anchor Point (+) clicks a point onto an outline without changing its shape, Delete Anchor Point (-) clicks one out (Option swaps the two while held), and Anchor Point (Shift+C) converts points between smooth and corner and drags one handle alone. Press and hold the Pen (or right-click it) for the group's flyout, Option-click it to step through the group, or tear the group off into a toolbar of its own with the strip at the flyout's edge; the Shape tools work the same way. Below them, the selection's thread swatch: click it for the thread color picker.

Diungkapkan bahwa curves, the illustrator way: the pen clicks corners and click-drags curves (option while dragging breaks the handle for a sharp turn; shift keeps points and handles at 45°; hold space to move the point you're placing). Click the first point to close a shape; Enter, Esc, ⌘-click or another tool ends a line and keeps it. With a path selected, the Pen continues it from an open end, adds a point on its outline, deletes a point you click, and Option-click turns a point corner ↔ smooth (Option-drag pulls out new handles). The cursor shows what a click will do. While drawing, click another open path's end to join the two into one. Click the last point to make it a corner, or drag from it to start the next curve in a new direction. Direct Selection drags points and handles of any shape from your SVG (circles and rects become paths); dragging a curve bends it under the pointer (Option-drag bends a straight one; a plain drag moves it); Delete removes points, arrows nudge them.

Diungkapkan bahwa smart guides while drawing (view › smart guides, ⌘u): pen points, shape corners and dragged points land on other objects' anchors and centers, where two outlines cross, on an outline, on 45° rays from the last point (level and upright handles too), or in line with any of those, with a magenta label saying which ("anchor", "intersect", "path", "align"…). With Shift, a point keeps its 45° angle and slides into line with the nearest target.

Diungkapkan bahwa round corners: in direct selection a small circle sits inside each sharp corner; drag it in to round the corners (the selected points', or all of them), each only as far as its sides allow. Object › Path › Round Corners… does the same with a radius and Round, Inverted or Chamfer, previewed live.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, brush (b), after illustrator's paintbrush: paint a line freehand and it comes out smooth, sewn as a satin column at the width you set (or as a running stitch). Smoothness takes out the hand's wobble; sharp turns stay sharp; end where you began to close the line. The cursor is a circle as wide as the satin.

Berdasarkan laporan, shapes, the illustrator way: rectangle (m), ellipse (l), polygon, star and line (\). The bar at the top of the canvas switches shapes and sets corner radius, sides, points and the star's inner radius. Click without dragging to type an exact size. Drag from a corner; Option draws from the center, Shift makes a square or circle, keeps a polygon or star upright and a line at 45°. While dragging a polygon or star, ↑/↓ add or remove sides or points. Closed shapes come in as fills, lines as runs, in the current thread.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, path tools: object › pathfinder (unite, minus front, intersect, exclude; also buttons in the transform panel when two or more objects are selected) and object › path (offset path…, outline stroke, simplify…, round corners…, clean up…). Simplify… is VectorCraft's slider, from fewest points to closest to the original, previewed live, with Auto-Simplify picking the level for the selection's size. Clean Up… removes stray points, objects too small to sew (under 1 mm by default) and extra points (points on top of each other, points in the middle of straight lines), showing how many of each it found first. Results come back as smooth curves with their real corners (least-squares curve fitting), not as many-sided polygons.

Diungkapkan bahwa logos from images (image trace): open, drop or place a png, jpeg, webp, gif, bmp or tiff and the trace image window traces it into flat-color shapes, previewed on your hat's color. png -o logo. Choose how many colors (or Auto), the width, detail and the smallest speck to keep; remove the white background; snap every color to your Brother, Janome or own palette's threads; and sew thin lines as single lines. The command line traces too: zigzag convert logo. Flat logos trace exactly (edges placed to a fraction of a pixel, corners restored, circles and straight lines exact); photos are posterized. pes.

Berdasarkan laporan, contextual task bar: under the selection, the next things you'd do: its stitch type, its thread, edit points, round corners, simplify, unite (two or more), duplicate. View › Contextual Task Bar (or its ••• menu) hides it.

Diungkapkan bahwa ask an agent: the agent panel (full height in the left dock; the sparkle at the bottom of the tool strip opens and closes it, and ⌘k or window › ask agent… opens it with the prompt ready) runs claude code or codex in the background, connected to this studio's mcp server, so you watch it build the design. On the canvas, the objects it's working on get a moving outline, a shimmer and a label saying what it's doing (Drawing, Placing, Restyling…), for any agent connected over MCP, not just the panel's. Uses the claude or codex command you've already signed in to. The transcript shows what it said and each step, with a spinner on the one running (the one place it's shown; collapse the panel and its header shows the step and the time instead). It can only use the design tools (no shell, no file edits). The panel is named for the agent (Claude Code or Codex; switch in its ≡ menu); + in its header starts a new chat, Stop ends a run. Like any panel it can float, join another as a tab or dock right; sharing a dock it sits at the bottom, under a divider you drag to give it more room.

Berdasarkan laporan, thread colors and palettes: the picker shows the nearest brother/janome thread, a palette to click (brother, janome or your own), and a small custom color field. Make palettes from scratch, from the design, or from a thread kit you own (the palette's ≡ menu › New Palette from Thread Kit: Brother's 12, 40 and 22 color sets, or 40 + 22 for all 61; then Match All keeps a design to the threads in your box), add the selection's thread with +, right-click to remove; they're remembered between launches.

Sebagaimana diketahui, threads panel: the design's threads in sewing order (each color block numbered, with its stitches, and "stop" where the same thread comes twice running) or by color (each thread once, with how many objects use it). Click a row to select what it sews; click a swatch to change that block's thread, or in By Color that thread everywhere. Group Colors and the count of color changes and trims are under the list. The panel's ≡ menu has Match All to the chosen palette, and Show Palette puts a palette to click under the list (off by default, since the thread picker has the same palettes).

Diungkapkan bahwa panels, the illustrator way: the agent has the left dock to itself; objects, stitch, transform, lettering, threads and document are on the right. » at the top of a dock collapses it to a strip of icons for a bigger canvas: click an icon and the panel flies out beside the strip (drag an icon to move that panel). Drag a panel by its header to reorder it, move it to the other dock, or drop it on the canvas to float it (each panel's ≡ menu also has Dock Left / Dock Right / Float). The design's issues are in the status bar (bottom right): a warning sign with a count, or a check when all's well; click it (or Window › Issues) for the list, each linked to its object. Drop a panel on another panel's header and they share it as tabs; drag a tab out (or use Separate in the ≡ menu) to part them, drag the header to move the group. Click a header to collapse a panel; Window › Reset Panels puts everything back. The layout is remembered.

Diungkapkan bahwa tabs, one per document (as in vectorcraft and illustrator): open, drop or new opens a file in a tab of its own over the canvas (the empty document you start with makes way for the first one); a file that's already open just comes forward. A dot in place of the × marks unsaved changes, and closing such a tab asks whether to save it first. Right-click a tab for Close Other Tabs and Copy Path. Each tab keeps its own undo history, selection, zoom and stitches. Click a tab to switch, ⌃Tab / ⌃⇧Tab (or Window › Next / Previous Document) to step through them, drag one to reorder, middle-click or its × (or File › Close, ⌘W) to close it; + opens a new document and » lists every tab when they don't all fit. Quitting doesn't ask: every tab comes back next time, each with its unsaved changes.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, menu bar (file, edit, object, view, window) with the usual ⌘ shortcuts. It's the real macOS menu bar on a Mac, drawn in the window elsewhere.

Cursors drawn for each tool: the Pen's nib (with what a click will do), crosshairs for the Shape, Measure and Fill Angle tools, Direct Selection's hollow arrow, and a curved arrow at rotate corners.

Right-click menus on the canvas and the Objects list, styled like the tool flyouts: the stitch types with their icons, then the usual commands with their shortcuts.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, stays quick on big designs: stitches are planned once per change, reusing every object that didn't change (overlap removal too: moving one object redoes only the objects it overlaps); a design that takes more than 12 ms to plan plans in the background (the status bar says "updating stitches…" and the last plan stays on screen meanwhile; when you drop a moved object its stitches move with it until the new plan lands). For development: TL_PROFILE=1 prints each frame's sections to stderr, TL_NO_GPU=1 draws the stitches with the painter instead, and cargo test --release --features gui --bin zigzag-studio perf_bench -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1 times typing and dragging on a traced logo (examples/bench-grid. An object whose stitches hit an internal error is left out with a warning in Issues rather than taking the plan down. The stitches live on the GPU: each color block's segments are uploaded once and drawn by a shader (thread shading and needle points included), so panning, zooming, dragging and the stitch player cost nothing per stitch on the CPU, whether the design has a thousand stitches or half a million. The Objects list lays out only the rows in view. Dragging points or objects, and typing, preview without re-planning until you let go. svg is a 213,000-stitch design for the studio itself).

Follows the system's light or dark appearance (ZIGZAG_THEME=light|dark overrides) and uses the San Francisco system font on a Mac.

Sebagaimana diketahui, pick a stitch type per object: big buttons, the task bar, right-click, or f/s/r/c/x (blanket and manual from the stitch panel). The preview re-plans live.

Diungkapkan bahwa layout, the illustrator way: drag to move (shift: 45° steps; option: drag a copy). The Transform panel has Illustrator's reference point: X/Y show the chosen point and W/H resize around it. Handles resize freely (Shift keeps proportions, Option resizes from the center, drag past the far side to flip); just outside a corner rotates (Shift: 45°). 5 mm (Shift 5 mm). Smart guides snap edges and centers to other objects and the hoop (View › Smart Guides, ⌘U). Hold Space to pan with any tool (a tap plays the stitch-out). ⌘D is Transform Again: Option-drag a copy, then ⌘D for more at the same spacing. Also rotate, flip, center in hoop, fit to hoop (artwork bigger than the hoop is scaled down to fit when you open or place it; Undo restores full size), ⌘C/⌘V, arrows nudge 0. Edits are saved as SVG transforms.

Sebagaimana diketahui, groups work like illustrator: a click or drag takes the whole group; double-click goes into it (the rest dims and a breadcrumb shows where you are), double-click again to go deeper; esc or double-click on empty canvas comes back out. ⌘-click picks one object without going in. Layers (Illustrator's "Layer 1", Inkscape layers, Figma frames) aren't groups. Copy, paste and duplicate keep groups.

Sebagaimana diketahui, type (t), as in vectorcraft and illustrator: click where the text should go and type straight onto the canvas (enter for a new line, esc or a click elsewhere when done); click text, or between its letters, to edit it with the caret where you clicked (or double-click it with the selection tool, which picks text anywhere in its box and shows it as a box, not its letters' points; delete every letter and finish, and the text is removed) (←/→, ↑/↓, home/end and ⌘←/→ move it; backspace and delete remove either side; shift with any of those, a drag, a double-click for a word, a triple-click or ⌘a for the lot selects text, which typing replaces and ⌘c/⌘x/⌘v copy, cut and paste); click a selected path to put text on it. The Lettering panel is a compact Character panel (hat text isn't long copy): font (with search), bold/italic, letter height, tracking, pair kerning (pick the pair, or Option+←/→ while typing kerns the pair at the caret), horizontal and vertical scale, case (as typed, UPPER, lower, Title), alignment and leading for two-line text, baseline (straight, arc over, arc under, or on a path with offset and flip), and the stitch type. The Type menu has Type on a Path, Change Case, Align and Create Outlines (⇧⌘O). Text is a shape like any other: Direct Selection, Round Corners, Simplify, Pathfinder and Clean Up all work on it (it quietly becomes plain paths at the first point-level edit, one undo step), and it saves as real SVG text until then.

Berdasarkan laporan, pen (p): draw filled shapes or lines with corners and curves, or place manual stitches one by one. Snaps to the grid when it's showing, else to smart guides.

Shapes (M, L, \): rectangles (with rounded corners), ellipses, polygons, stars and lines.

Measure, mm grid, needle points, First/Last, Group colors.

Open machine files (PES, PEC, DST, EXP, JEF) to view, resize and re-export them, and images to trace.

Diungkapkan bahwa settings per type: fill angle (with a drag-to-set angle tool, a), spacing, length, pull, underlay. Satin options: column vs border, stitch (satin, S-stitch, zig-zag), threads across the column, width, underlay passes, short stitches. Cross-stitch: cell size. Contour and ripple: rings or spiral. Tartan: the stripes (color and width each, mirrored), angle, row spacing. Run options: single or triple.

Berdasarkan laporan, sewing row in the stitch panel: start and end (click the outline; green and red markers you can drag), trim and stop after the object. Edit › Copy / Paste Stitch Settings carries one object's type and settings to others (each keeps its thread and start/end); Edit › Select Same Stitch Type; Object › Path › Reverse Direction sews a path from its other end.

Test swatches (Object › Test Swatches…): copies of the selection in a grid, one setting (spacing, length, pull compensation, satin width, fill angle) stepped from a value to another, each lettered with its value, to stitch out and compare on the real fabric.

Diungkapkan bahwa view › density map tints where stitches pile up (yellow from 2. 5 per mm², red at 4), and View › Sewing Order numbers the objects on the canvas.

Berdasarkan laporan, fabric preset, hoop, remove overlaps and cap order in the document panel. Preview on your hat's color.

Diungkapkan bahwa issues list (status bar): problems link to the object. Satins show their rails on the canvas.

Diungkapkan bahwa sewing order: earlier/later. Stitch player (Space). Undo/redo everything.

Save (Ctrl/⌘ S) writes settings into the SVG; Export PES/DST/EXP/JEF/VP3/PEC/PEN or a worksheet (HTML: picture, size, time, every color stop with the nearest Brother and Janome thread); Send to Skitch.

Berdasarkan laporan, measuring and units. Measure (I) works like VectorCraft's: drag between two points to read the distance, angle, width and height. The ends snap to points, edges and the hoop (or to the grid when it's on), Shift keeps the line to 45°, and the reading stays until the next drag (Escape clears it). View › Units, or the unit menu in the status bar, shows sizes, positions, distances and the grid in millimeters, centimeters, inches, points or pixels (SVG pixels, 1/96 in, as files are read); it's remembered between launches. 4mm, 10+5). The grid (⌘') follows the unit, inches in halves down to 1/32, and labels its major lines along the canvas's top and left edges from the hoop's center. Any length field also takes a typed unit or a sum (1/4 in, 25. Stitch settings (spacing, density, pull compensation) stay in millimeters.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, picks up where you left off. If the app went down while bringing a document back, the next launch keeps it aside as recovery-crashed. Opening the app with a file skips this. svg instead of trying again (and an unreadable one as recovery-unreadable. Quit (or crash) and reopen: the same files come back, every tab with any unsaved changes, the zoom and the selection, and the same tab in front. A job on the Skitch comes back too: the design last sent is kept (sent. svg…, in ZigZag's settings folder (~/Library/Application Support/ZigZag), each written whole or not at all), never written into your file until you save. svg), and says so in the status bar. json and one recovery file per tab, recovery. Changes are kept as you work (session. svg, recovery-2. json), the Skitch window reopens if it was open and reconnects, and once the machine reports that design its progress shows on it again (the machine keeps the design and where the needle is; Stop ends the job on both).

Sebagaimana diketahui, the studio runs an mcp server on http://127. 1:7878/mcp (Streamable HTTP, localhost only, Origin-checked). 0. 0. Agents edit the live document you're looking at (the tab in front), and every call is one undo step.

Sebagaimana diketahui, mcp in the status bar (bottom right, next to the skitch) shows whether agents can reach the studio: a gray dot while it waits, green once a client has connected, blue and pulsing while calls come in, red if the server couldn't start. Click it for the address, the commands to connect Claude Code and Claude Desktop (with Copy buttons), the clients that have connected, the recent tool calls (failed ones in red, with the error on hover) and the tools on offer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, claude desktop / stdio clients (claude_desktop_config. json):.

Sebagaimana diketahui, zigzag-mcp forwards to the running studio. Use --port N if you changed it. With "args": ["--headless"] it works without the app open: the same tools on a document no one is watching (zigzag-studio --mcp-stdio), kept only when the agent saves or exports it.

Arguments a tool doesn't take are refused with the ones it does (a misspelt widht_mm isn't silently ignored), and each tool says whether it only reads.

Diungkapkan bahwa try asking: "draw a 50 mm round badge with mountains and a sun for my thin cotton cap, check it, and show me the preview. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa export with file → export → export as → svg (styling: presentation attributes, object ids: layer names). Outline text, or it falls back to system fonts. Opening the ZigZag-saved SVG back in Illustrator keeps the settings in the layer names.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, name layers or objects to set their stitching. Illustrator's _x3D_-style escapes are decoded, and group settings apply to everything inside the group.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, example layer names: logo fill a=45 s=0. satin stroke. 35, title satin, outline stroke. w=1. 5.

The Skitch window (the toolbar's Send button or File › Send to Skitch…) runs the whole job, like a slicer's device page follows a print: the design on the left, what to do on the right, and the steps across the top (Connect · Home · Send · Trial · Sew · Done).

Diungkapkan bahwa agents can send_to_skitch and follow along with machine_status. The protocol was reverse-engineered (see NOTICE), so avoid firmware updates.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, thread tension isn't a bluetooth setting on the skitch: it's the tension dial on the machine. Speed is fixed (about 400 stitches a minute). The machine does report a block of settings, and Artspira has a settings screen, so two tools are here for working out what else it can do:.

Writing settings stays out of ZigZag until a layout is known and a write of the machine's own settings, unchanged, reads back the same.

Checked against Ink/Stitch's features and tool docs:.

Checked against Wilcom Hatch's core feature set:.

#210. T-Mobile illegally imposed 50GB cap on low-income home Internet plan, NY says

📅 11 Nov 2026

T-Mobile illegally imposed 50GB cap on low-income home Internet plan, NY says

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/11/t-mobile-illegally-imposed-50-gb-cap-on-low-income-home-internet-plan-ny-says/

Sebagaimana diketahui, law requires 25mbps home internet. T-Mobile lowers speed to 600Kbps after 50GB cap.

T-Mobile violated a New York state law by imposing a 50GB-per-month data cap and reducing speeds to less than a megabit per second on home Internet plans it is required to offer people with low incomes, New York government officials alleged.

Sebagaimana diketahui, t-mobile agreed to a settlement requiring it to scrap the data and speed limits, to offer the required low-income plans to more parts of the state, and to make it easier for customers to find information about the plans. The settlement requires T-Mobile to eliminate the speed limits and expand availability of the plans within 120 days.

Berdasarkan laporan, the alleged legal violation and the settlement are related to t-mobile’s wireless home internet service, not the company’s mobile plans. Governor Kathy Hochul and New York Attorney General Letitia James announced the settlement on Monday, saying that a state investigation found T-Mobile violated the New York Affordable Broadband Act (ABA).

Sebagaimana diketahui, the state law doesn’t specifically mention data caps, but it requires home internet providers with at least 20,000 customers to offer plans at specific prices and minimum speeds to people who meet income-eligibility requirements. T-Mobile’s policy of reducing speeds after customers exceed a monthly data cap violates the law, New York officials said.

“An investigation by the Office of the Attorney General (OAG) found T-Mobile’s offerings did not meet the ABA’s requirements, which mandate that home Internet providers offer high-speed broadband to income-eligible households for $15 per month at speeds of at least 25 Mbps, or $20 per month for speeds of at least 200 Mbps,” the press release said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, new york says in the settlement with t-mobile that “after the data cap is reached, the customer’s maximum download speed is reduced from 25 mbps to 600 kbps. ” New York’s press release said “a typical customer could hit the data cap after about four days of usage. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, data caps and speed limits aren’t the only restrictions. T-Mobile also “only offers ABA Internet plans to customers in homes that are eligible for 5G home Internet,” preventing residents in 4G-only areas from accessing the plans, the settlement says. The company also prevented search engines from indexing the webpage that provides detailed information about eligibility for and enrollment in ABA plans, it says.

“T-Mobile did not fully comply with the New York Affordable Broadband Act,” New York said in the settlement.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, t-mobile’s aba webpage confirms that customers are provided only 50gb per month and that speeds after using the allotment are merely “up to 600 kbps. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, although the settlement includes a list of the new york ag’s findings, t-mobile did not admit to any violation. “Respondent neither admits nor denies the OAG’s Finding in paragraph 1-14 above,” the document says.

Berdasarkan laporan, new york started enforcing the affordable broadband act in january 2025 after winning a nearly four-year court battle against broadband industry lobby groups that tried to kill the law. The groups that sued New York in a failed effort to block the law included CTIA, the wireless industry association that represents T-Mobile and other carriers. The law finally took effect a month after the Supreme Court rejected the broadband industry’s challenge.

When contacted by Ars, T-Mobile did not explain why it imposed the restrictions on low-income plans.

Diungkapkan bahwa “we have a long history of helping customers in new york stay connected through low-cost broadband, and we’re updating our plan to meet the state’s requirements while maintaining the same low price,” t-mobile said in a statement. “We’ve reached an agreement with the New York attorney general that builds on that commitment, provides greater clarity around our offering and makes the plan available to more eligible customers. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the settlement with new york applies to t-mobile’s fixed wireless internet plans, which can be used for home internet service as an alternative to wired broadband. The fixed wireless Internet relies on T-Mobile’s cellular network but provides access at a single location, delivering wireless signals to receivers installed at customer homes.

Berdasarkan laporan, it took almost 18 months for new york to investigate t-mobile’s compliance and reach a settlement with the company. “In June 2025, the New York Department of Public Service contacted the OAG and relayed concerns about certain features of the plan that T-Mobile was offering to customers eligible for reduced-price Internet service under the ABA,” the settlement said.

Berdasarkan laporan, it seems that isps have generally offered the required plans, though cable company optimum failed to comply until ars made some inquiries on behalf of a customer who could not obtain the plan he was entitled to shortly after the law took effect. ISPs knew about the law long in advance due to the multiyear court case that they initiated, but Optimum wasn’t ready to comply with the requirement and rejected the low-income man’s request twice.

Sebagaimana diketahui, new york officials said the ag’s office “found that t-mobile was only offering aba plans in areas where it had deployed 5g wireless service, even though it offered full-price internet plans that could deliver 25 mbps download speeds in areas where it had 4g service. In addition, T-Mobile specifically coded its website to hide its ABA plan information from search engines, making it difficult for New Yorkers searching for low-priced Internet to find their plans. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the settlement requires t-mobile to stop intentionally limiting download speeds, and says the “temporary reduction of download speeds due solely to network congestion shall not constitute a violation of this assurance. ” There’s also an exception in the state law, which says ISPs shall provide 25Mbps “subject to exceptions adopted by the Public Service Commission where such download speed is not reasonably practicable. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, extending the low-cost service to 4g areas, t-mobile agreed to provide the low-income plans “at every address at which respondent offers residential fixed wireless internet service. ” Speeds lower than 25 Mbps would not violate the settlement if T-Mobile “would be unable to provide a minimum download speed of 25 megabits per second to a residential fixed wireless Internet service customer enrolled in a non-ABA Plan at the same address. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the document says that “t-mobile offers 5g home internet to roughly 40 percent of homes in rural areas of upstate new york and 4g (lte) home internet to the remainder of homes in the regions where t-mobile offers fixed wireless service. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to make its aba webpage more accessible, the settlement says t-mobile “shall not include a noindex tag on the webpage, or otherwise prevent search engines from indexing the webpage or presenting a link to the webpage in response to search engine queries. ” T-Mobile must also prominently link to the ABA webpage on the part of its website that lists or describes its standard home Internet deals.

Sebagaimana diketahui, new york could sue t-mobile if it violates the settlement. The ABA’s enforcement mechanism requires the attorney general to sue a broadband provider on behalf of residents. Such lawsuits can recover restitution and civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation.

Berdasarkan laporan, isps that want to raise another challenge to new york’s law could get help from the trump administration, which asserts that states must not enforce price regulations or net neutrality laws against any isp that obtains grants from the $42 billion broadband equity, access, and deployment (bead) program. The grants have not been distributed yet, and California argues that the Trump administration does not have authority to preempt such laws.

In addition to this week’s settlement, New York struck a deal with T-Mobile last month over the carrier violating its promise to never raise prices on certain mobile plans that came with a lifetime price guarantee.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a state investigation “found that from 2017 to 2019, t-mobile advertised ‘price guarantee plans’ to its 4g customers, promising to ‘never change the price you pay,’” the new york attorney general’s office said on october 20. “However, in 2024, T-Mobile changed course and began raising the price of these plans by approximately $5 per phone line. New Yorkers enrolled in approximately 252,957 of these Price Guarantee Plans saw their phone bills increase. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa t-mobile agreed to give affected customers several reimbursement options and a price lock until may 2029. The attorney general’s office estimated that the agreement would provide up to $38 million in value to customers affected by the price hikes. T-Mobile also agreed to pay the state a fine of $98,834. 75.

T-Mobile provided a statement on the price-hike settlement.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “the $38 million cited in the press release is an estimate of potential benefits that a group of long-standing t-mobile customers may choose to take advantage of, not the amount in refunds or payments,” t-mobile said. We’re glad to have this matter resolved and remain focused on delivering value to our customers. “The agreement provides for approximately $98,000 paid to the state and a range of optional customer benefits. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ars technica has been separating the signal from the noise for over 25 years. With our unique combination of technical savvy and wide-ranging interest in the technological arts and sciences, Ars is the trusted source in a sea of information. After all, you don’t need to know everything, only what’s important.

Samsung reportedly in talks to buy data centre cooling firm Modine

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://thenextweb.com/news/samsung-modine-talks-data-centre-cooling

Samsung Electronics is in talks to acquire Modine Manufacturing, the Wisconsin maker of cooling systems for data centres, Bloomberg reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.

Berdasarkan laporan, a transaction could come together within weeks, per bloomberg’s sources, though no final decision has been made; the talks could still collapse, and another suitor could yet emerge. Samsung and Modine both declined to comment.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the market voted early. 10, a market value of about $5. Modine closed regular trading at $106. 6B, then soared past $135 in late trading, a 28% jump.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the stock had fallen around 15% since 3 november, when quarterly results underwhelmed investors. Samsung, worth about $910B after a 72% run this year, rose as much as 3. 9% in Seoul before paring gains.

Sebagaimana diketahui, modine is an odd-sounding prize with a very current shape. Based in Racine, Wisconsin, the company spent decades making heavy-duty heating and cooling for commercial buildings and industrial machines; in October it spun off its automotive business to become a pure-play thermal-management company.

Its fastest-growing unit serves the hyperscalers building data centres, growing 86% annually over the past three fiscal years, per Bloomberg Intelligence, which also notes Modine is small next to the big HVAC makers, “making it an attractive target for vertical integration in AI infrastructure”.

Diungkapkan bahwa for samsung, the logic is diversification. The group remains heavily dependent on its memory business, and while chips generate enormous cash, analysts have long pushed it toward growth businesses adjacent to the AI boom. Cooling qualifies: as racks get denser and chips hotter, thermal management has become one of the scarcest skills in the data centre buildout.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nor would it be samsung’s first move in the category. The company bought Germany’s FläktGroup, another cooling specialist, for €1. 5B last year; a Modine takeover would be a far bolder cheque.

Rivals are circling the same market, with Daikin, LG Electronics, and Vertiv all chasing data-centre thermal demand, part of a broader wave of incumbents pivoting toward AI infrastructure.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the deal would say something about where the ai gold rush’s money is flowing next. The chips get the headlines, but every GPU needs its heat carried away, and the companies that do the plumbing are suddenly worth fighting over.

#213. Apple Support Community Is Shutting Down, as DIY Advice Bites the Dust

📅 11 Nov 2026

Apple Support Community Is Shutting Down, as DIY Advice Bites the Dust

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/apple-support-community-shutting-down-diy-advice-dead/

Our gifting experts are obsessively searching for holiday gifts that are unique, thoughtful and suitable for any budget.

Diungkapkan bahwa our expert, award-winning staff selects the products we cover and rigorously researches and tests our top picks. If you buy through our links, we may earn a commission.

Even if the site was no longer very useful, it's still sad to lose free peer support.

Senior Editor / Home Security and Smart Home.

Senior Editor / Home Security and Smart Home.

Berdasarkan laporan, when people tried visiting the apple support community site on tuesday, they found not only that new posts were blocked, but that apple is planning to shut down the forums permanently on nov. 20. If you want to look up a specific Apple troubleshooting topic on iPhones or HomePods, now’s the time to do it. Soon, the entire peer advice and support site, which has been operating for nearly three decades, will be gone.

Berdasarkan laporan, apple was a pioneer in community support forums before the aughts, letting people discuss their mac issues as early as 1998. For those of you who might remember, that’s the year Apple debuted its iMac G3, the desktop with a translucent blue teardrop-shaped case. The iMac G3 abandoned legacy ports and the floppy disk drive in favor of CD-ROM and USB.

Berdasarkan laporan, back then, the site was called apple tech exchange, later renamed apple discussions until it eventually became the apple support community in 2011. Many still turned to forums for DIY solutions, using it to get advice from other tinkerers interested in figuring out how to fix things on their own.

Sebagaimana diketahui, an apple spokesperson told cnet the decision was made “after careful evaluation of our strategy and our customers’ needs. ” Apple’s site notification directs people to visit the official Apple Support site. You’ll also be able to use Apple’s online chat, support phone numbers and in-store support, the same way they worked in the past.

Diungkapkan bahwa apple is one of the first american tech companies to give up its community discussion site — google still has google communities help, and amazon manages its own forum domain with discussions from both staff and users. But Apple’s sudden closure could indicate a major shift, with others eventually following suit. It has highlighted an ongoing discussion about the role of peer support in tech, how AI has changed our online conversations and more.

When news of the shutdown spread, Apple users flocked to the internet to express everything from dismay to vindication.

Berdasarkan laporan, for many, the apple support community forums were controversial, not least because it wasn’t always clear how they worked. The site contained “user-submitted content, comments and opinions” and was “for informational purposes only,” yet many would mistake it for official Apple Support from staff.

Diungkapkan bahwa in discussions on reddit about the closure, many bemoaned the absence of real apple employees from the site’s forums and found the advice from other support community users to often be frustrating and not worth the effort. On the unofficial Apple subreddit, many mourned the loss of community while also noting that answers on the forum were often much harder to come by. Others said the site grew less helpful over the years.

Diungkapkan bahwa cnet phone reviewer and senior editor mike sorrentino told me that the forum shutdown “will likely drive customers looking for help with basic questions to apple’s official support articles rather than user-created threads. ” But Sorrentino also acknowledged that the move reflects a general trend away from the site, with more people getting answers from sites like Reddit. “Apple’s always been big on controlling what information is shown on its website, and in that view, moving away from user discussion makes sense,” he said.

Berdasarkan laporan, just this week, i used the apple support community site when looking for an answer to a problem implementing apple intelligence on my home security cameras, which required jumping through multiple hoops. Perhaps tellingly, I ended up finding the correct answer on Reddit myself. But that could become harder to do in the near future.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the shutdown of apple’s peer support forums is definitely a sign of the times, especially as tech companies push users away from repairing their own devices and toward replacing them outright — or at least encourage device owners to pay for official support services. It’s also a sign of the growing role of artificial intelligence, which is capitalizing on user-created content to provide summaries, moving people away from organic discussion and exchange on sites like these.

Berdasarkan laporan, reddit has lucrative data-licensing contracts with google and openai, allowing the companies to train their ai models on reddit’s massive archive of human discussions, as well as surface reddit content in tools like google ai overviews and chatgpt. Reddit is also moving to a login-only viewing mode, making it significantly harder for casual users to find answers unless they trust AI summaries.

Sebagaimana diketahui, apple may be leery of keeping so much user knowledge online for ai models to scrape for their own answers. The company may also want to prevent AI summaries from providing information from past forum users on how to jailbreak Apple devices or DIY fixes, even as the EU has mandated that Apple start building replaceable batteries by next year. And it wouldn’t be a good look if Siri AI started regurgitating incorrect or outdated info it had picked up from Apple’s own sites.

Berdasarkan laporan, whatever the reason, the circle of apple users helping users has grown smaller, and that doesn’t bode well for support forums as a whole. It may be time to start archiving those years of data before other tech companies implement similar plans.

#215. Ring’s new drone patrols your home to keep an eye on things – even upstairs

📅 10 Nov 2026

Ring’s new drone patrols your home to keep an eye on things – even upstairs

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.zdnet.com/home-and-office/ring-drone-cam-rover-cam-security-robots/

Our gifting experts are obsessively searching for holiday gifts that are unique, thoughtful and suitable for any budget.

Home & Office > Smart Home > Home Security.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, alongside the ring drone cam, ring introduced the rover cam for businesses. It investigates disturbances and streams 4K footage.

Today, Ring announced the launch of a new subbrand, Ring Robotics, with two new products: the $249 Ring Drone Cam, an indoor “mobile security camera” drone that shoots 2K video, and the $999 Ring Rover Cam, a security robot for businesses that patrols autonomously and investigates disturbances.

Also: Amazon’s new Echo Studio gives Alexa+ an AI camera to see inside your home.

Sebagaimana diketahui, both devices use ring’s custom navigation software, “ai pilot,” to autonomously navigate interior spaces and move between set points along a patrol, rather than being controlled directly by the user. AI Pilot leverages the devices’ cameras, sensors, and vision models, along with cloud processing, to create interior maps, then move the devices between predesignated patrol points such as a side door or a window.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i recently saw both new robots in person at a showcase in new york hosted by ring’s founder and chief inventor, jamie siminoff. They certainly do what they advertise but come with some significant limitations. The drone, for example, can only stay in the air for about 8 minutes before it needs to dock and recharge, while the Ring Rover Cam is slow and deliberate, seemingly ideal for routine surveillance rather than rapid response to an event.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the ring drone cam moves around predetermined patrol points in your home, sending you a live 2k video feed whether you’re just in another room or out of town. The user doesn’t actually fly the drone; instead, it moves around autonomously using Ring’s custom “AI Pilot” navigation technology, leveraging its cameras, sensors, and cloud processing to create a map of its surroundings. This allows it to fly through the air at an appropriate height, going from room to room, even up stairs.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in the ring app, the user creates patrol points they want the drone to move between — likely a window, doorway, or high-traffic room — creating a set path that is both predictable (so you always know where the drone will go) and relevant, so it’s only monitoring the areas you want it to. But here is where its limitations come into play: It needs a finite path to navigate because its flight time is limited to just five to eight minutes in the air before it has to return to its charging dock.

Berdasarkan laporan, that makes the dock both the start and end point for the drone’s routine trips, and it’s designed with this in mind. When it goes to land, the drone hovers over the dock and lowers itself down, dropping into place so it can start charging automatically. I asked about its potential to land elsewhere, and Ring told me it would only make an emergency landing outside of its dock in case it didn’t have enough power to get home.

Also: Amazon’s new Echo Dot can turn into a Wi-Fi extender – how it works.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there’s one other very important caveat: this thing is loud. There’s no sneaking up on anyone with the Ring Drone Cam, as the entire household is likely to hear it the second it undocks. The four propellers emit a constant, high-pitched whirring while in the air that’s loud enough to announce its presence to anyone in the vicinity: intruder or resident.

Sebagaimana diketahui, during the product briefing, siminoff insinuated that this was part of its design to dissuade home intruders snooping around your house at night (especially when paired with the drone’s front-facing spotlight), but it’s likely just the result of its engineering, especially considering this is a first-gen product. It’s so loud that it makes me think it’s better suited to navigating the home when no one’s home (although whether or not your pets go bonkers trying to catch it is a whole other issue).

The Ring Drone is designed to work out of the box with the existing Ring ecosystem, including the 2K Video Doorbell and Indoor Cam, and is also compatible with Amazon’s Map View.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the ring drone cam will start shipping on jan. 27, 2027, and will cost $249.

Diungkapkan bahwa the other product ring announced is the rover cam, a mobile robot with a 4k camera designed to monitor large spaces like warehouses, offices, or businesses. Ring calls it a “security guard that never clocks out,” but it’s more like a slow-moving droid that goes on set patrol paths. It leverages the same AI Pilot technology as the Ring Drone to map its surroundings and navigate around shelving, furniture, and obstacles in real time.

Diungkapkan bahwa it’s much quieter than its airborne sibling, traveling at low speeds and offering mobile surveillance instead of wiring every square inch of a large space. If the technology here looks familiar, it’s because it resembles the Amazon Astra, a smaller robot designed for home monitoring but with a very similar build.

Diungkapkan bahwa the idea here is to deploy the robot to certain areas of a workplace via the app, then get 360-degree views once it’s there. Like the drone, it can also set out on automated routes at select timing intervals — like right after a business closes or before it opens. During working hours, it chugs along with its camera, capturing everything in its view.

Also: The 4 biggest Amazon smart home announcements from today.

Diungkapkan bahwa if another ring device is triggered, the rover cam autonomously goes to investigate the disturbance, providing 4k footage in real time via the app. It also features a periscope camera that can extend to see over obstacles like shelving, counters, or furniture, providing a high-level view if needed. In case you lose it in a large warehouse or office, it has a “light tower” that projects light upward onto the ceiling, notifying users of its location.

Diungkapkan bahwa even when docked, it uses motion-sensing technology to start recording the second it senses any kind of movement, just like ring doorbell cameras. In case of an emergency, the Rover features a siren and red flashing lights to dissuade intruders.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the ring rover cam is available for preorder now and will start shipping on dec. 16, 2026. It will cost $999.

Today, weâre rolling out Gemini 4 Hydrogen inside Google Antigravity alongside a new model dropdown option called Orchestrator, which pairs Hydrogen with our strongest models for long-horizon tasks, including Gemini 4 Carbon, in an optimized balance of quality, efficiency, and latency.

Selecting Orchestrator (Carbon) from the model selector in Google Antigravity.

Berdasarkan laporan, earlier this week, we introduced gemini 4 carbon alongside /swarm for tackling massive, multi-worktree engineering tasks with parallel agent teams. In just a couple of days, tens of thousands of swarms have been launched on Antigravity, pushing frontier intelligence on the hardest problems.

Berdasarkan laporan, for everyday feature work and debugging inside a single session, running a frontier reasoning model with multiple parallel agents on every step of every routine task slows down your loop and burns frontier quota. A common industry approach is to use a static âmodel routerâ that guesses task difficulty from your first prompt and routes the entire task to the cheapest model that is good enough to complete the task. Unfortunately, these start breaking down as agents become longer running, requiring different levels of complexity at different stages, often discovered as the task evolves.

Diungkapkan bahwa orchestrator takes a dynamic, bidirectional approach between carbon and gemini 4 hydrogen within the evolution of a single trajectory. This allows Orchestrator to reach near-Carbon task success while being faster and more quota-efficient. Hydrogen could then take over to write edits, update packages, and run tests. For example, Carbon can start in a read-only phase to explore dependencies, resolve ambiguities, and build a concrete plan with explicit re-planning triggers. If Hydrogen hits friction, it would hand back to Carbon to inspect the state, repair the plan, and resume execution. On Terminal-Bench 4. 1, Orchestrator reached near-Carbon task success rates while, on average, consuming 24% less quota and completing 19% faster.

Anduril says its first satellite can see adversaries maneuver in orbital night

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://arstechnica.com/space/2026/11/anduril-demos-night-vision-sensor-for-tracking-satellites-in-darkness/

Diungkapkan bahwa “what’s unique is it’s got a huge dynamic range. We can see things in full dark. ”.

Anduril Industries has announced the successful demonstration of a new satellite-based sensor designed to track other spacecraft that may be hiding their maneuvers in Earth’s shadow.

Funded with Anduril’s internal capital, the company’s oven-sized satellite launched on a SpaceX rideshare mission in July with a package of tech demo payloads: an edge-compute processor, a power-management system adaptable to different mission types, and a long-wave infrared space sensor capable of detecting other objects in orbit.

Sebagaimana diketahui, anduril reported on the success of the tech demo mission tuesday. The company’s satellite, named Anduril-216, flies about 590 km (366 mi) above Earth, spending about one-third of each orbit in darkness. Anduril-216’s night passes allow its infrared imager to shine.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “this is a unique sensor that allows us to take imagery in long-wave [infrared],” said gokul subramanian, anduril’s senior vice president of engineering. “What’s unique about that is it’s got a huge dynamic range. It has very low solar exclusion, so we’re blocked by the Sun very rarely, and we can see things in full dark. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the us military and a growing number of commercial data providers use a network of radars and optical sensors on the ground and in space to monitor satellite traffic. Anduril acquired one of the commercial satellite-tracking companies, ExoAnalytic Solutions, earlier this year. But there’s a gap in optical tracking as satellites fly in Earth’s shadow, so space traffic monitors could temporarily lose track of a spacecraft if it performs a maneuver in orbital night.

Diungkapkan bahwa the space force is charged with tracking satellites for two primary reasons. First, military commanders want to know if an adversary moves its satellite in a threatening manner. Second, the Space Force issues traffic alerts to global satellite operators if there’s a risk of a collision.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “right now, we don’t have ground sensors in our adversaries’ sovereign lands, and then in the eclipse period where we are relying heavily on visible sensors, the satellites that are not illuminated by the sun, we can’t see those,” said adam thurn, vice president and general manager of orbital systems at anduril. “With the long-wave infrared space sensor, we’re looking to close that gap. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa anduril’s long-wave infrared sensor works by detecting heat signatures from spacecraft, even in periods of eclipse. It provides a “unique capability for us to witness when an adversary or other resident space objects are maneuvering during those eclipse periods, where in the past we’ve been fairly blind,” Thurn said.

Berdasarkan laporan, in creating the infrared space sensor, engineers applied imaging technology anduril uses in its autonomous weapons for use in space. Anduril released a single image Tuesday from the sensor on Anduril-216 showing an infrared view of the Moon above Earth’s horizon. The Moon image offers just a taste of what the instrument can do, Thurn said.

Berdasarkan laporan, “the long-wave infrared capability we have on orbit can do both unresolved and resolved imagery,” thurn said, suggesting anduril’s sensor could be used to inspect other satellites in orbit if it flies close enough. For now, Thurn said Anduril is focusing on optimizing its tracking sensor for low-Earth orbit, but it could be used in other orbits, and eventually in cislunar space near the Moon.

Diungkapkan bahwa apex space, a satellite-manufacturing startup, built the spacecraft platform for anduril-216. Subramanian said Anduril has no plans to start its own satellite production line. Instead, Anduril foresees buying third-party satellite platforms and integrating them with sensor and compute modules to perform a range of different missions in space.

Diungkapkan bahwa “you’re seeing that today with anduril-216, where we started with a simple mission, which was how do we track satellites, especially in these eclipse periods where the us currently does not have the ability to maintain custody,” subramanian said. “And we designed a mission around that. ”.

The compute module on Anduril-216 is designed to fuse data from different kinds of sensors, such as infrared or visible imagers, and generate tracking solutions on its own, without intervention or analysis from the ground.

Berdasarkan laporan, subramanian said anduril’s current focus is on acquiring space domain awareness data for sale to the us military, not selling entire satellites or sensors to the government. “That could change in the future. “At present, Anduril is not offering this system as a merchant supplier,” he said. ”.

#221. Donald Trump’s AI task force takes on the hacks that AI agents carry out themselves

📅 13 Nov 2026

Donald Trump’s AI task force takes on the hacks that AI agents carry out themselves

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://thenextweb.com/news/trump-ai-task-force-ai-cyberattacks-reporting

The group discussed incident-reporting standards as the law underpinning US cyber information-sharing expires next month.

Donald Trump speaks to reporters on the White House South Lawn.

Members of Donald Trump’s AI task force met on Thursday to discuss how to get critical US sectors to report AI-powered cyberattacks, a Trump administration spokesperson told Reuters.

The task force, a group of advisers expected to shape the administration’s approach to AI, is responding to a problem that stopped being hypothetical this year: AI agents attacking systems without a human telling them to.

Diungkapkan bahwa the clearest case came over the summer, when an openai agent broke out of its testing environment and attacked the ai platform hugging face. OpenAI and other AI firms subsequently disclosed a series of similar agentic breakouts, often weeks or months after they happened, and in some cases only after independent researchers found them first.

Sebagaimana diketahui, two ideas were on thursday’s table, per the administration’s statement. Emil Michael, the Defence Department’s technology lead and the task force’s vice chair, described progress on national standards for AI developers to report safety incidents and share cybersecurity information.

The group also discussed ways to let critical infrastructure providers, the banks, energy firms, and emergency services whose failure causes real-world harm, come forward about vulnerabilities and attacks without fear of legal consequences.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the legal scaffolding underneath all of this is about to lapse. The Cybersecurity Information Sharing Act of 2015, which lets businesses swap threat intelligence with each other and the government by shielding defensive monitoring from wiretap and surveillance rules, expires next month. Industry considers it a pillar of collective defence; without it, the lawyers get a veto over the threat feeds.

Governments on both sides of the Atlantic spent this year reacting to agentic AI’s first real incidents, from the safety pledges signed in Paris to the EU leaders meeting in Dublin today with rogue agents on their minds.

Meanwhile, the companies keep shipping: OpenAI is pushing business agents into enterprises at exactly the moment Washington is asking how to find out when one goes wrong.

Reporting standards only help if the incidents get reported, and the record so far, with disclosures arriving months late or extracted by outside researchers, suggests the industry will not volunteer the bad news on its own.

Again, the Lofree Hyzen also supports an impressive roster of compatible magnetic switches, but lacks the professional polish of Keychron’s boards.

Berdasarkan laporan, the “hybrid” moniker also has another related meaning. The V6 Ultra Hybrid is a hybrid board for both work and play, offering powerful gaming performance while capable enough to handle the rigors of work and heavy typing.

Diungkapkan bahwa the bit that excites me most are two of the magnetic switch choices available from stock. The V6 Ultra Hybrid ships with one of four Gateron Ultra Fast Lime magnetic switches, two of which are tactile. Yes, tactile magnetic switches — this is the biggest news in my opinion.

Diungkapkan bahwa all magnetic switches up to now have been linear in operation. If, like me, you enjoy tactile switches but want magnetic gaming performance, you’ve so far been left out in the cold. Sure, being able to hot-swap those is fine, but swapping out 108 switches from a full-sized keyboard is a ginormous time suck. So it’s not like you can just quickly switch from tactiles for work to magnetic for gaming. Not anymore.

Diungkapkan bahwa the v6 ultra hybrid also packs plenty of keychron’s productivity heritage. As you can see, my typing speed and accuracy were both above average on the V6 Ultra Hybrid, helped by paring back the actuation to 2. There’s a gasket mount, for bouncy and comfortable typing; Keychron’s steeply-raked and deeply-sculpted OSA profile keycaps, which I find ideal for fast typing; and screw-in stabilizers for minimal big key wobble. 6mm — my personal sweet spot and where I type-test all magnetic boards. I could (and indeed did) type on this thing all day.

Diungkapkan bahwa thanks to gateron’s magnetic switches, you also get every elite gaming feature under the sun right now: adjustable actuation; rapid trigger; dynamic keystroke for multiple commands per actuation; custom socd resolutions for last key prioritization (a. K. There’s 8K polling too, although on a keyboard this is tantamount to snake oil, if you ask me. A. ‘Snap Tap’). All of this is customizable through Keychron’s fantastic web launcher.

Diungkapkan bahwa i used the board for everything, from competitive gaming on “counter-strike 2” and “wardogs,” through to more relaxed titles like “total war: rome ii,” “valheim,” and “dune: awakening. ” It never put a foot wrong.

Berdasarkan laporan, admittedly, if you want a board purely for competitive fps gaming, you’re probably better off with a plate-, tray-, or top-mounted magnetic board like the nuphy air60 he, nuphy field75 he, or keychron q16 he 8k — these mount styles aren’t as comfortable, but move around less than a gasket mount, making them less likely to cause accidental inputs at super low <0. 5mm switch actuations.

If you need an all-rounder for both work and play, though, I seriously can’t think of a better board than the V6 Ultra Hybrid.

Berdasarkan laporan, as this is a keychron board, you get all the expected goodies. Aside from some QC issues I’ll cover later, the board is built well, using premium materials. The case is sturdy ABS plastic with very little bend and flex — impressive given this is a long board.

Diungkapkan bahwa the keycaps are doubleshot pbt, which will stand up well to wear and tear without going shiny, unlike abs keycaps. ), and the V6’s keycaps picked up a lot of grease but were easy to wipe down. PBT is also grease resistant. I did my usual test, typing on the keyboard after eating Monster Munch (a fried corn snack here in the U. K. Not quite as impressive as the caps on the Logitech G Pro X2 Rapid, which completely resisted the same grease altogether — like not even a single smear.

Berdasarkan laporan, the v6 features a decent 4,000mah battery, plus triple bluetooth, 2. This is a longstanding frustration of mine. I switch between the two OS’ constantly for work. There’s a macOS/Windows toggle, too, but Keychron still supplies separate sets of Windows and macOS command keys rather than dual-labeling its keycaps. It’s great to have the toggle, but it undermines the ease if I have to switch keycaps too. 4G and wired connectivity, toggleable via a switch on the case. A small issue, but one that’s so easily solvable by dual labelling — as proved by the Lofree Hyzen and Lofree Flow 2.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when i reviewed the original keychron v6, which i awarded a full five stars, one of my favorite features was the price. The V6 Ultra Hybrid 8K HE is pricier. It offered major performance for a very reasonable sum. It costs $164 versus the $99 basic V6 and the $119 V6 Ultra (which has faster polling, better internal damping, nicer switches, etc — just an all-round upgraded package).

Berdasarkan laporan, however, the v6 ultra hybrid packs a lot more functionality than the lower-tier v6 models thanks to the dual mx/he switch compatibility, and way more gaming features when using he switches. An extra $45 over the standard V6 Ultra is fair game for all that, at least in my book.

Sebagaimana diketahui, let’s look at the hybrid mx/he competition, too. The Glorious GMMK 3 HE starts at $179, but you can easily get up to near $500 for choice productivity upgrades (and to make it look less ugly than stock). The Lofree Hyzen costs a whopping $279 — sure it’s made from aluminum and is beautiful to behold, but the software is janky as hell. By those two yardsticks, the V6 Ultra Hybrid 8K HE is the best value-for-money hybrid board on the market, and it ain’t even close.

At the time of writing, the V6 Ultra Hybrid 8K HE is in pre-order, after its Kickstarter campaign, with estimated shipping starting December 2026.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as i’ve mentioned in previous reviews, i absolutely hate that keychron floats its new boards on kickstarter. Keychron is a major keyboard brand (arguably the dominant productivity market force) that absolutely does not need to crowdfund its boards. Besides, as someone who has tested several of Keychron’s crowdfunded boards, I can tell you they’re already developed and practically finished by the start of the campaigns (because most Keychron boards are 95% the same under the hood). Oh well. That’s just unfortunately how Keychron chooses to operate, but you can rest assured that there’s usually very little chance of a crowdfunding rug pull from this brand.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there’s very little i don’t like about the v6 ultra hybrid 8k he, aside from its ridiculously long-winded name. It’s a little boring to look at, I guess, and I saw some QC teething issues, but nothing that should seriously dissuade you.

Diungkapkan bahwa ah, look: black plastic case, gray rounded keycaps, a tiny bit of color on the esc key. It must be a Keychron! Yawn. I’m not saying the V6 Ultra Hybrid is bad-looking, but it’s the same old Keychron design we’ve seen for years now. And it’s getting kinda boring.

Berdasarkan laporan, now, as someone who has owned, tested, used, or edited the reviews of literally hundreds of keyboards, this probably affects me more than you. I see a lot of Keychrons; you’ll probably only see the one you buy.

Diungkapkan bahwa but man, i wish keychron would make some more exciting decks in its more affordable v- and k-series sometimes. Pretty boards with plenty of color, like the NuPhy Halo75; or handsome futuristic designs like the Lofree Hyzen and Lofree Block. Come on, Keychron, spice it up a bit.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as keychron has grown, i’ve seen firsthand its once stellar reputation for build quality start to drop. And Keychron is always keen to hear from us when this happens, so we always tell its representatives and receive a replacement in quick order. Not all the time, I must say. Now we’re seeing frequent issues with sticky switches or other build quality concerns. A few years ago, every single Keychron board we tested was built like a tank. But it’s getting to the point now that I’m seeing a pattern I can’t ignore.

Berdasarkan laporan, my first v6 ultra hybrid review unit suffered both a sticky switch (solved by adjusting debounce time) and a usb dongle port that was far too large with no magnet inside, meaning the 2. Keychron’s representative has assured me this was a pre-production teething issue, and issued me a full production unit where the problem has been fixed. But as I said above, similar issues are becoming too common now from this once wholly reliable brand, and it’s a problem I need to call out. 4G receiver would fall out. Keychron, if you’re reading, please step your game back up.

Berdasarkan laporan, i utterly adore this keyboard. I won’t be using it long-term because I prefer a 75% layout (so I‘m eagerly waiting for a V2 Ultra Hybrid 8K HE). But I absolutely love what this deck signifies.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as is so often the case in the productivity keyboard arena, it takes keychron to turn its attention to an innovation to truly bring that feature into the mainstream and make it work. Dual MX/HE compatibility is now here, with proper wide-ranging switch support for both mechanical and magnetic. And there’s a tactile magnetic switch on offer to boot.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you want one keyboard that excels for literally every purpose, without breaking the bank, it’s the keychron v6 ultra hybrid 8k he. End of story.

#224. How AI security failures are endangering your supply chain – and what you can do

📅 10 Nov 2026

How AI security failures are endangering your supply chain – and what you can do

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.zdnet.com/tech/ai-security-failures-supply-chain-risks-black-kite-research/

Our gifting experts are obsessively searching for holiday gifts that are unique, thoughtful and suitable for any budget.

New research provides a stark look at the AI supply chain and the risks it brings to businesses.

Artificial intelligence companies worldwide are bringing a new wave of vulnerabilities and security issues to the digital supply chain, researchers warn.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, according to a new report published by black kite on tuesday, there now exists a “widespread cybersecurity weakness” across the “rapidly expanding ecosystem of companies developing, deploying, and supporting artificial intelligence. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ai and smart solutions don’t automatically equate with safe solutions. In a study titled “2026 AI Supply Chain Report: The Risks Behind Your AI Relationships,” Black Kite says that many AI suppliers — the companies that develop and deploy AI services to today’s businesses — are struggling with “basic security practices. ”.

Also: Rogue AI incidents hit ‘tens of thousands’: Can businesses trust these tools?.

According to the research, after examining the companies themselves, along with their software, integrations, and components, researchers found failures to patch critical vulnerabilities, protect credentials, authenticate users and email, and address network security issues.

Diungkapkan bahwa the study analyzes 18,160 ai companies worldwide, ranging from 0-10 employees to more than 1,000 employees. A company’s AI involvement was determined through reviews of company products and services and primary business activities, covering six broad groups: everyday application development; AI development and implementation; AI applications in specialized sectors such as healthcare, IT, and finance; industrial organizations; and AI foundations working on data, compute, and modeling.

A small percentage of assessed companies are considered “unclassified,” and the study excluded businesses that use AI only incidentally.

Diungkapkan bahwa in addition, unusual network activity was detected at 44. 3% of organizations, and botnet-related activity was recorded at 41. 8% of AI companies.

AI’s main business appeal is its ability to integrate with existing software and platforms to handle manual tasks, heavy lifting, and tedious, time-consuming work, freeing employees to focus on work that requires human oversight.

Diungkapkan bahwa enterprises are investing billions of dollars in ai. Menlo’s 2026 research estimates that enterprise AI spend reached $37 billion in 2025, with half of overall spend going to AI apps. In total, 76% of enterprise AI solutions are purchased rather than built internally.

However, the moment an AI or automated component is introduced into a corporate ecosystem or operational platform, any security problems it has impact the user — and each additional integration, such as software components or open-source tooling, may also increase the attack surface.

Berdasarkan laporan, in an accompanying analysis of ai firms’ use of model context protocol (mcp) components, which can link ai apps to business systems, 48. 8% of 1,732 logged security findings were rated High or Critical, including code and command injection vulnerabilities.

Also: The new enterprise AI expert every company needs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s not just the ai application itself. As noted by Black Kite, AI suppliers often have access to customer data, developer environments, business infrastructure, and enterprise platforms. If the supplier’s credentials are stolen, this could expose its customers to a range of cyberattacks.

Diungkapkan bahwa the researchers found, for example, that 19. 9% of AI companies offering solutions for enterprise AI deployment had corporate login information in infostealer records, and that stolen corporate logins, overall, were linked to 6. 8% of AI suppliers in the study.

Sebagaimana diketahui, visibility matters, too, for businesses that should be monitoring their digital supply chains. However, 33. 2% of AI companies assessed have a “limited” digital footprint, including their domains, subdomains, and IP addresses.

The same principles for protecting the digital supply chain apply to AI suppliers, where continual monitoring and assessment are among the best protections businesses have.

Berdasarkan laporan, staying informed and aware of the risks to your own business makes all the difference. As recommended by Black Kite, it takes more than a single point-in-time security assessment — frequent monitoring and engaging with suppliers to understand their technologies and dependencies can reveal potential security issues.

Also: Do you need AI agent liability insurance?.

If you find weaknesses, manage them by priority, handling ransomware-related exposures and vulnerabilities actively exploited in the wild first.

Sebagaimana diketahui, also audit an ai tool’s integrations and components, access, what data it can reach, and the potential impact of exploitation. Once you’re armed with this information, it’s possible to weigh risk and reward — and whether the AI tool is worth the potential attack exposure it brings. If you decide to keep it, limit its permissions and access to what it requires.
